japeddhyāyet pūjayettāṃ sarvasiddhyaiviṣādihṛt //
308.d:
ईशः किरातरूपो ऽभूत् पुरा गौरी च तादृशी /
जपेद्ध्यायेत् पूजयेत्तां सर्वसिद्ध्यैविषादिहृत् //
308.m: The Lord assumed the form of a Kirāta mountain hunter of old, and Gaurī took a similar form. / One should recite [her mantra], meditate on her, and worship her for all supernatural powers, as the remover of poison and [other ills].

308.s:
aṣṭasiṃhāsane pūjyā dale pūrvādike kramāt /
aṅgagāyatrī praṇītā hūṅkārādyā dalāgrake //
308.d:
अष्टसिंहासने पूज्या दले पूर्वादिके क्रमात् /
अङ्गगायत्री प्रणीता हूङ्काराद्या दलाग्रके //
308.m: She should be worshipped upon an eight-[petalled] lion throne, on the petals starting from the east in order. / The limb-gāyatrī mantras, Praṇītā, Hūṅkārā, and the rest, are worshipped on the tips of the petals,

308.s:
phaṭkārī cāgrato devyāḥ śrīvījenārcayedimāḥ /
lokeśāyudhavarṇāstāḥ phaṭkārī tu dhanurdharā //
308.d:
फट्कारी चाग्रतो देव्याः श्रीवीजेनार्चयेदिमाः /
लोकेशायुधवर्णास्ताः फट्कारी तु धनुर्धरा //
308.m: and Phaṭkārī before the goddess. One should worship these with the seed-syllable Śrī. / They have the colors of the weapons of the guardians of the quarters, while Phaṭkārī holds a bow.

308.s:
jayā ca vijayā dvāsthe pūjye sauvarṇayaṣṭike /
kiṅkarā varvarī muṇḍī laguḍī ca tayorvahiḥ //
308.d:
जया च विजया द्वास्थे पूज्ये सौवर्णयष्टिके /
किङ्करा वर्वरी मुण्डी लगुडी च तयोर्वहिः //
308.m: Jayā and Vijayā, holding golden staffs, are to be worshipped at the entrance. / Outside them are Kiṅkarā, Varvarī, Muṇḍī, and Laguḍī.

308.s:
iṣṭvaivaṃ siddhayeddravyaiḥ kuṇḍe yonyākṛtau hunet /
hemalābho 'rjunair dhānyair godhūmaiḥ puṣṭisampadaḥ //
308.d:
इष्ट्वैवं सिद्धयेद्द्रव्यैः कुण्डे योन्याकृतौ हुनेत् /
हेमलाभो ऽर्जुनैर् धान्यैर् गोधूमैः पुष्टिसम्पदः //
308.m: Having thus worshipped, one achieves success through the substances; one should offer fire oblations in a yoni-shaped fire-pit. / Acquisition of gold is gained through arjuna flowers, and nourishment and prosperity through grains of wheat.

308.s:
yavair dhānyaistilaiḥ sarvasiddhirītivināśanam /
akṣair unmattatā śatroḥ śālmalībhiś ca māraṇam //
308.d:
यवैर् धान्यैस्तिलैः सर्वसिद्धिरीतिविनाशनम् /
अक्षैर् उन्मत्तता शत्रोः शाल्मलीभिश् च मारणम् //
308.m: Through barley, grains, and sesame, one attains all perfections and the destruction of calamities; / through akṣa fruits comes madness of the enemy, and death through śālmali flowers.

308.s:
jambubhirdhanadhānyāptistuṣṭirnīlotpalair api /
raktātpalair mahāpuṣṭiḥ kundapuṣpair mahodayaḥ //
308.m: Through jambu fruits comes the acquisition of wealth and grain, and satisfaction through blue lotuses; / through red lotuses comes great nourishment, and through kunda flowers comes great fortune.

308.s:
mallikābhiḥ purakṣobhaḥ kumudair janavar labhaḥ /
aśokaiḥ putralābhaḥ syāt pāṭalābhiḥ śubhāṅganā //
308.d:
मल्लिकाभिः पुरक्षोभः कुमुदैर् जनवर् लभः /
अशोकैः पुत्रलाभः स्यात् पाटलाभिः शुभाङ्गना //
308.m: Through mallikā jasmines comes the agitation of a city, and through white water-lilies one becomes beloved of the people; / through aśoka blossoms one obtains a son, and through pāṭalā flowers an auspicious woman.

308.s:
āmrair āyustilair lakṣmīrbilvaiḥ śrīś campakair dhanam /
iṣṭaṃ madhukapuṣpaiś ca bilvaiḥ sarvajṇatāṃ labhet //
308.d:
आम्रैर् आयुस्तिलैर् लक्ष्मीर्बिल्वैः श्रीश् चम्पकैर् धनम् /
इष्टं मधुकपुष्पैश् च बिल्वैः सर्वज्णतां लभेत् //
308.m: Through mango blossoms comes long life, through sesame prosperity, through bilva fruits fortune, through campaka flowers wealth; / what is desired is obtained through madhuka flowers, and through bilvas one attains omniscience.

From three hundred thousand recitations comes the attainment of everything, through fire oblations, meditation, and likewise through worship. / Having worshipped in the maṇḍala with the Gāyatrī, one should offer twenty-five oblations.
[Page 135]

308.s:
dadyācchatatrayaṃ mūlāt pallavair dīkṣito bhavet /
pañcagavyaṃ purā pītvā carukaṃ prāśayetsadā //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāpūjā nāmāṣṭādhikatriśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha navādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tvaritāmantrādiḥ
308.d:
दद्याच्छतत्रयं मूलात् पल्लवैर् दीक्षितो भवेत् /
पञ्चगव्यं पुरा पीत्वा चरुकं प्राशयेत्सदा //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्वरितापूजा नामाष्टाधिकत्रिशततमो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ नवाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
त्वरितामन्त्रादिः
308.m:
One should offer three hundred [oblations] from the root-mantra; one who is initiated should perform it with tender shoots. / Having first drunk the five products of the cow, one should always consume the sacred food oblation.
Thus ends the three hundred and eighth chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named 'The Worship of Tvaritā'.
Now, the three hundred and ninth chapter.
The Mantras of Tvaritā and Others.

309.s:
agnir uvāca
aparāṃ tvaritāvidyāṃ vakṣye 'haṃ bhuktimuktidāṃ /
pure vajrākule(1) devīṃ rajobhirlikhite yajet //
309.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
अपरां त्वरिताविद्यां वक्ष्ये ऽहं भुक्तिमुक्तिदां /
पुरे वज्राकुले(1) देवीं रजोभिर्लिखिते यजेत् //
309.m: Agni said: / I shall proclaim another Tvaritā lore that bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation. / One should worship the goddess in a city enclosed by thunderbolts, drawn with colored powders.

309.s:
padmagarbhe digvidikṣu cāṣṭau vajrāṇi vīthikāṃ /
dvāraśobhopaśobhāñca likhecchrīghraṃ smarennaraḥ //
309.d:
पद्मगर्भे दिग्विदिक्षु चाष्टौ वज्राणि वीथिकां /
द्वारशोभोपशोभाञ्च लिखेच्छ्रीघ्रं स्मरेन्नरः //
309.m: In the center of the lotus, in the cardinal and intermediate directions, [one should draw] eight thunderbolts and an aisle, / and a man should swiftly draw the adornment and subsidiary adornment of the doorway and meditate.

309.s:
aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ siṃhe vāmajaṅghā pratiṣṭhitā /
dakṣiṇā dviguṇā tasyāḥ pādapīṭhe samarpitā //
309.d:
अष्टादशभुजां सिंहे वामजङ्घा प्रतिष्ठिता /
दक्षिणा द्विगुणा तस्याः पादपीठे समर्पिता //
309.m: She has eighteen arms; her left shank rests on a lion; / her right leg is bent double and set upon a footstool.

309.s:
nāgabhūṣāṃ vajrakuṇḍe khaḍgaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ karamāt /
śūlaṃ śaraṃ tathā śaktiṃ varadaṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ //
309.d:
नागभूषां वज्रकुण्डे खड्गं चक्रं गदां करमात् /
शूलं शरं तथा शक्तिं वरदं दक्षिणैः करैः //
309.m: She has serpent ornaments, thunderbolt earrings, and holds in order a sword, a discus, a mace, / a trident, an arrow, a spear, and gives boons with her right hands.

309.s:
dhanuḥ pāśaṃ śaraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tarjanīṃśaṅkhamaṅkuśam /
abhayañca tathā varjaṃ vāmapārśve dhṛtāyudham //
309.d:
धनुः पाशं शरं घण्टां तर्जनींशङ्खमङ्कुशम् /
अभयञ्च तथा वर्जं वामपार्श्वे धृतायुधम् //
309.m: She holds a bow, a noose, an arrow, a bell, the gesture of warning, a conch, a goad, / protection, and a thunderbolt as weapons on her left side.

309.s:
pūjanācchatrunāśaḥ syādrāṣṭraṃ jayati līlayā /
dīrghāyūrāṣṭrabhūtiḥ syāddivyādisiddhibhāk //
:n
1 vajrārgale iti ña..
:p 136
309.d:
पूजनाच्छत्रुनाशः स्याद्राष्ट्रं जयति लीलया /
दीर्घायूराष्ट्रभूतिः स्याद्दिव्यादिसिद्धिभाक् //
:न्
1 वज्रार्गले इति ञ..
:प् 136
309.m:
From her worship, destruction of enemies takes place, and one easily conquers a kingdom; / one attains long life, the prosperity of a kingdom, and celestial and other accomplishments.
[Footnote]
1. In manuscript ña: "vajrārgale".
[Page 136]

309.s:
taletisaptapātālāḥ kālāgnibhuvanāntakāḥ /
oṃ kārādisvarārabhya yāvadbrahmāṇḍavācakam //
309.d:
तलेतिसप्तपातालाः कालाग्निभुवनान्तकाः /
ओं कारादिस्वरारभ्य यावद्ब्रह्माण्डवाचकम् //
309.m: There are the seven subterranean realms ending in Tala, and worlds culminating in the Fire of Dissolution. / Beginning with vowels starting from the syllable oṃ, up to the indicator of the universe,

309.s:
oṃ kārādbhrāmayettoyantotalā tvaritā tataḥ /
prastāvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi svaravargaṃ likhedbhuvi //
309.d:
ओं काराद्भ्रामयेत्तोयन्तोतला त्वरिता ततः /
प्रस्तावं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि स्वरवर्गं लिखेद्भुवि //
309.m: one should circulate water from the syllable oṃ; then [worship] Totalā and Tvaritā. / I shall now declare the arrangement [of phonemes]: one should write the class of vowels on the ground.

309.s:
tālurvargaḥ kavargaḥ syāttṛtīyo jihvatālukaḥ /
caturthastālujihvāgro jihvādantastu pañcamaḥ //
309.d:
तालुर्वर्गः कवर्गः स्यात्तृतीयो जिह्वतालुकः /
चतुर्थस्तालुजिह्वाग्रो जिह्वादन्तस्तु पञ्चमः //
309.m: The palatal class is the gutturals [ka-varga]; the third is the tongue-palatal; / the fourth is tongue-and-palate-tip; the fifth is tongue-and-teeth.

309.s:
ṣaṣṭho 'ṣṭapuṭasampanno miśravargastu saptamaḥ /
ūṣmāṇaḥ syācchvargastu uddharecca manuṃ tataḥ //
309.d:
षष्ठो ऽष्टपुटसम्पन्नो मिश्रवर्गस्तु सप्तमः /
ऊष्माणः स्याच्छ्वर्गस्तु उद्धरेच्च मनुं ततः //
309.m: The sixth is provided with eight enclosures, and the seventh is the mixed class; / the sibilants make up the sixth class, and from them one should extract the mantra.

309.s:
ṣaṣṭhasvarasamārūḍhaṃ ūṣmaṇāntaṃ savindukam /
tāluvargadvitīyantu svaraikādaśayojitam //
309.d:
षष्ठस्वरसमारूढं ऊष्मणान्तं सविन्दुकम् /
तालुवर्गद्वितीयन्तु स्वरैकादशयोजितम् //
309.m: Mounted on the sixth vowel, ending with a sibilant, with a nasal dot; / then the second of the palatal class joined with the eleventh vowel.

309.s:
jihvātālusamāyogaḥ prathamaṃ kevalaṃ bhavet /
tadeva ca dvitīyantu adhastādviniyojayet //
309.d:
जिह्वातालुसमायोगः प्रथमं केवलं भवेत् /
तदेव च द्वितीयन्तु अधस्ताद्विनियोजयेत् //
309.m: The union of tongue and palate should be the first alone; / and one should affix that very second beneath.

309.s:
ekādaśasvarair yuktaṃ prathamaṃ tāluvargataḥ /
ūṣmāṇasya(1) dvitīyantu adhastād dṛśya yojayet //
309.d:
एकादशस्वरैर् युक्तं प्रथमं तालुवर्गतः /
ऊष्माणस्य(1) द्वितीयन्तु अधस्ताद् दृश्य योजयेत् //
309.m: Joined with the eleventh vowel, the first from the palatal class; / and observing the second of the sibilants, one should attach it beneath.

309.s:
ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktamūṣmāṇasya dvitīyakam /
jihvādantasamāyoge prathamaṃ yojayedadhaḥ //
309.d:
षोडशस्वरसंयुक्तमूष्माणस्य द्वितीयकम् /
जिह्वादन्तसमायोगे प्रथमं योजयेदधः //
309.m: Joined with the sixteenth vowel, the second of the sibilants; / in the union of tongue and teeth, one should join the first beneath.

309.s:
miśravargād dvitīyantu adhastāt punareva tu /
caturthasvarasambhinnaṃ tāluvargādisaṃyutam //
309.d:
मिश्रवर्गाद् द्वितीयन्तु अधस्तात् पुनरेव तु /
चतुर्थस्वरसम्भिन्नं तालुवर्गादिसंयुतम् //
309.m: Again the second from the mixed class beneath; / combined with the fourth vowel, joined with the beginning of the palatal class.

309.s:
ūṣmaṇaś ca dvitīyantu adhastādviniyojayet /
svaraikādaśabhinnantu ūṣmaṇāntaṃ savindukam //
309.d:
ऊष्मणश् च द्वितीयन्तु अधस्ताद्विनियोजयेत् /
स्वरैकादशभिन्नन्तु ऊष्मणान्तं सविन्दुकम् //
309.m: One should attach the second of the sibilants beneath; / separated by the eleventh vowel, ending with a sibilant, with a nasal dot.

309.s:
pañcasvarasamārūḍhaṃ oṣṭhasampuṭayogataḥ /
dvitīyamakṣarañcānyajjihvāgre tāluyogataḥ //
:n
1 ūṣmāṇasyetyayaṃ pāṭho na sādhuḥ
:p 137
309.d:
पञ्चस्वरसमारूढं ओष्ठसम्पुटयोगतः /
द्वितीयमक्षरञ्चान्यज्जिह्वाग्रे तालुयोगतः //
:न्
1 ऊष्माणस्येत्ययं पाठो न साधुः
:प् 137
309.m:
Mounted on the fifth vowel, by the combination of lips pursed together; / and another second syllable at the tip of the tongue with the contact of the palate.
[Footnote]
1. The reading *ūṣmāṇasya* is not correct.
[Page 137]

309.s:
prathamaṃ pañcame yojyaṃ svarārdhenoddhṛtā ime /
oṃkārādyā namontāś ca japet svāhāgnikāryake //
oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraḥ hṛdayaṃ hāṃ hṛśceti śiraḥ /
hrīṃ jvala jjalaśikhā syāt kavacaṃ hanudvayam / hrīṃ śrīṃ
kṣūnnetratrayāya vidyānetraṃ prakīrtitam kṣauṃ haḥ khauṃ
hūṃ phaḍastrāya guhyāṅgāni purā nyaset
309.d:
प्रथमं पञ्चमे योज्यं स्वरार्धेनोद्धृता इमे /
ओंकाराद्या नमोन्ताश् च जपेत् स्वाहाग्निकार्यके //
ओं ह्रीं ह्रूं ह्रः हृदयं हां हृश्चेति शिरः /
ह्रीं ज्वल ज्जलशिखा स्यात् कवचं हनुद्वयम् / ह्रीं श्रीं
क्षून्नेत्रत्रयाय विद्यानेत्रं प्रकीर्तितम् क्षौं हः खौं
हूं फडस्त्राय गुह्याङ्गानि पुरा न्यसेत्
309.m:
The first should be joined to the fifth; extracted with half a vowel, these / beginning with oṃ and ending with namaḥ should be recited, and with svāhā in rites of fire.
"Oṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraḥ" is the heart; "hāṃ hṛḥ" is the head.
"Hrīṃ jvala jvala" is the crest-lock. The armor is the two jaws. "Hrīṃ śrīṃ kṣūṃ" to the three eyes is declared the eye of the vidyā. "Kṣauṃ haḥ khauṃ hūṃ phaṭ" to the weapon. One should first deposit the secret limbs.

309.s:
tvaritāṅgāni vakṣyāmi vidyāṅgāni śṛṇuṣva me /
ādidvihṛdayaṃ proktaṃ tricatuḥśira iṣyate //
309.d:
त्वरिताङ्गानि वक्ष्यामि विद्याङ्गानि शृणुष्व मे /
आदिद्विहृदयं प्रोक्तं त्रिचतुःशिर इष्यते //
309.m: I shall declare the ancillary limbs of Tvaritā. Hear from me the limbs of the vidyā: / The first two are declared the heart; the third and fourth are held to be the head;

309.s:
pañcaṣaṣṭhaḥ śikhā proktā kavacaṃ saptamāṣṭamam /
tārakantu bhavennetraṃ navārdhākṣaralakṣaṇaṃ //
309.d:
पञ्चषष्ठः शिखा प्रोक्ता कवचं सप्तमाष्टमम् /
तारकन्तु भवेन्नेत्रं नवार्धाक्षरलक्षणं //
309.m: The fifth and sixth are declared the crest-lock; the seventh and eighth are the armor; / And Tāraka is the eye, characterized by nine and a half syllables.

309.s:
totaleti samākhyātā vajratuṇḍe tato bhavet /
kha kha hūṃ daśavījā syādvajratuṇḍendradrūtikā //
309.d:
तोतलेति समाख्याता वज्रतुण्डे ततो भवेत् /
ख ख हूं दशवीजा स्याद्वज्रतुण्डेन्द्रद्रूतिका //
309.m: She is proclaimed as Totalā; then she becomes Vajratuṇḍā. / "Kha kha hūṃ" is the ten-syllabled [vidyā]; she is the messenger Vajratuṇḍendradrūtikā.

309.s:
khecari jvālinījvāle khakheti jvālinīdaśa /
varce śaravibhīṣaṇi khakheti ca śavaryapi //
309.d:
खेचरि ज्वालिनीज्वाले खखेति ज्वालिनीदश /
वर्चे शरविभीषणि खखेति च शवर्यपि //
309.m: "Khecari jvālinī jvāle kha kha" is the ten-[syllabled] Jvālinī. / "Varce śaravibhīṣaṇi kha kha" is also Śavarī.

309.s:
che chedani karālini khakheti ca karālyapi /
vakṣaḥśravadravaplavanī kha kha(1) dūtīplavaṃ khyapi //
309.d:
छे छेदनि करालिनि खखेति च कराल्यपि /
वक्षःश्रवद्रवप्लवनी ख ख(1) दूतीप्लवं ख्यपि //
309.m: "Che chedani karālini kha kha" is Karālī. / "Vakṣaḥśravadravaplavanī kha kha" is the messenger Plavā.

309.s:
strībālakāre dhunani śāstrī vasanavegikā /
kṣe pakṣe kapile hasa hasa kapilā nāma dūtikā //
309.d:
स्त्रीबालकारे धुननि शास्त्री वसनवेगिका /
क्षे पक्षे कपिले हस हस कपिला नाम दूतिका //
309.m: "Strībālakāre dhunani śāstrī vasanavegikā" / "Kṣe pakṣe kapile hasa hasa" is the messenger named Kapilā.

309.s:
hrūṃ tejovati raudrī ca mātaṅgaraudridūtikā /
puṭe puṭe kha kha khaḍge phaṭ brahmakadūtikā //
309.d:
ह्रूं तेजोवति रौद्री च मातङ्गरौद्रिदूतिका /
पुटे पुटे ख ख खड्गे फट् ब्रह्मकदूतिका //
309.m: "Hrūṃ tejovati raudrī" is the messenger Mātaṅgaraudrī. / "Puṭe puṭe kha kha khaḍge phaṭ" is the messenger Brahmakā.

309.s:
vaitālini daśārṇāḥ syustyajānyahipalālavat /
hṛdādikanyāsādau syān madhye netre nyasetsudhīḥ //
309.d:
वैतालिनि दशार्णाः स्युस्त्यजान्यहिपलालवत् /
हृदादिकन्यासादौ स्यान् मध्ये नेत्रे न्यसेत्सुधीः //
309.m: "Vaitālini"—they are ten-syllabled: "Abandon the other like serpent's straw." / In the beginning, the deposition of the heart and so forth takes place; in the middle, the wise one should deposit [the mantra] on the two eyes:

309.s:
pādādarabhya mūrdāntaṃ śira ārabhya pādayoḥ /
:n
1 vakṣaḥśravadravaplavanīthatheti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 138
aṅghrijānūruguhye ca nābhihṛtkaṇṭhadeśataḥ //
309.d:
पादादरभ्य मूर्दान्तं शिर आरभ्य पादयोः /
:न्
1 वक्षःश्रवद्रवप्लवनीथथेति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 138
अङ्घ्रिजानूरुगुह्ये च नाभिहृत्कण्ठदेशतः //
309.m:
Beginning from the feet up to the head, and beginning from the head down to the two feet,
[Footnote]
1 [Variant reading:] "vakṣaḥśravadravaplavanīthatheti" in manuscripts kha and cha. / [Page 138]
At the feet, knees, thighs, and genitals, and from the region of the navel, heart, and throat,

309.s:
vajramaṇḍalabūrdhe ca aghordhe cādivījataḥ /
somarūpaṃ tato gāvaṃ dhārāmṛtasuvarṣiṇam //
309.d:
वज्रमण्डलबूर्धे च अघोर्धे चादिवीजतः /
सोमरूपं ततो गावं धारामृतसुवर्षिणम् //
309.m: Above the vajra-maṇḍala, and above the Aghora [syllable], starting from the initial seed-syllable. / Then, [visualizing] the body of the form of the moon, showering streams of nectar,

309.s:
viśantaṃ brahmarandhreṇa sādhakastu vicintayet /
mūrdhāsyakaṇṭhahṛnnābhau guhyorujānupādayoḥ //
309.d:
विशन्तं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण साधकस्तु विचिन्तयेत् /
मूर्धास्यकण्ठहृन्नाभौ गुह्योरुजानुपादयोः //
309.m: The practitioner should meditate on it entering through the brahmarandhra. / On the head, mouth, throat, heart, navel, genitals, thighs, knees, and feet,

309.s:
ādivījaṃ nyasenmantrī tarjanyādi punaḥ punaḥ /
ūrdhaṃ somamadhaḥ padmaṃ śarīraṃ vījavigrahaṃ //
309.d:
आदिवीजं न्यसेन्मन्त्री तर्जन्यादि पुनः पुनः /
ऊर्धं सोममधः पद्मं शरीरं वीजविग्रहं //
309.m: The mantrin should repeatedly deposit the initial seed-syllable with the forefinger and other fingers. / The moon above, the lotus below, the body whose form is the seed-syllable—

309.s:
yo jānāti na mṛtyuḥ syāttasya na vyādhayo jvarā /
yajejjapettāṃ vinyasya dhyāyeddevīṃ śatāṣṭakam //
309.d:
यो जानाति न मृत्युः स्यात्तस्य न व्याधयो ज्वरा /
यजेज्जपेत्तां विन्यस्य ध्यायेद्देवीं शताष्टकम् //
309.m: For him who knows this, there is no death, nor diseases or fevers. / Having performed this ritual deposition, he should worship, recite, and meditate on the goddess one hundred and eight times.

309.s:
mudrā vakṣye praṇītādyāḥ praṇītāḥ pañcadhāsmṛtāḥ /
grathitau tu karau kṛtvā madhye 'ṅguṣṭhau nipātayet //
309.d:
मुद्रा वक्ष्ये प्रणीताद्याः प्रणीताः पञ्चधास्मृताः /
ग्रथितौ तु करौ कृत्वा मध्ये ऽङ्गुष्ठौ निपातयेत् //
309.m: I shall declare the mudrās, beginning with Praṇītā; the praṇītā mudrās are taught to be fivefold. / Having intertwined both hands, one should drop both thumbs into the middle;

309.s:
tarjanīṃ mūrdhnisaṃlagnāṃ vinyasettāṃ śiropari /
praṇīteyaṃ samākhyātā hṛddeśe tāṃ samānayet //
309.d:
तर्जनीं मूर्ध्निसंलग्नां विन्यसेत्तां शिरोपरि /
प्रणीतेयं समाख्याता हृद्देशे तां समानयेत् //
309.m: Bringing the forefinger in contact with the crown, one should place it upon the head: / This is proclaimed as Praṇītā; one should then bring it to the heart region.

309.s:
ūrdhantu kanyasāmadhye savījāntāṃ vidurdvijāḥ /
niyojya tarjanīmadhye 'nekalagnāṃ parasparām //
309.d:
ऊर्धन्तु कन्यसामध्ये सवीजान्तां विदुर्द्विजाः /
नियोज्य तर्जनीमध्ये ऽनेकलग्नां परस्पराम् //
309.m: The twice-born know [the gesture] pointing upward between the little fingers, terminating with the seed-syllable. / Having joined [the fingers] between the forefingers, joined mutually in manifold ways,

309.s:
jyeṣṭāgraṃ nikṣipenmadhye bhedanī sā prakīrtitā /
nābhideśe tu tāṃ baddhvā aṅguṣṭhāvutkṣipettataḥ //
309.d:
ज्येष्टाग्रं निक्षिपेन्मध्ये भेदनी सा प्रकीर्तिता /
नाभिदेशे तु तां बद्ध्वा अङ्गुष्ठावुत्क्षिपेत्ततः //
309.m: One should cast the tip of the thumb into the middle: that is declared as Bhedanī. / Having formed it at the navel region, one should then throw up both thumbs;

309.s:
karālī tu mahāmudrā hṛdaye yojya mantriṇaḥ /
punastu pūrvavad baddhalagnāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ samutkṣipet //
309.d:
कराली तु महामुद्रा हृदये योज्य मन्त्रिणः /
पुनस्तु पूर्ववद् बद्धलग्नां ज्येष्ठां समुत्क्षिपेत् //
309.m: Karālī is the great mudrā to be applied to the heart of the mantrin. / Then, joined as bound before, one should raise the thumb:

309.s:
vajratuṇḍā samākhyātā vajradeśe tu bandhayet /
ubhābhyāñcaiva hastābhyāṃ maṇibandhantu bandhayet //
309.d:
वज्रतुण्डा समाख्याता वज्रदेशे तु बन्धयेत् /
उभाभ्याञ्चैव हस्ताभ्यां मणिबन्धन्तु बन्धयेत् //
309.m: She is proclaimed as Vajratuṇḍā; one should bind it at the vajra region. / With both hands, one should fasten the wrist;

309.s:
trīṇi trīṇi prasāryeti(1) vajramudrā prakīrtitā /
:n
1 prasāryā ceti ṭa..
:p 139
daṇḍaḥ khaḍgañcakragadā mudrā cākārataḥ smṛtā //
309.d:
त्रीणि त्रीणि प्रसार्येति(1) वज्रमुद्रा प्रकीर्तिता /
:न्
1 प्रसार्या चेति ट..
:प् 139
दण्डः खड्गञ्चक्रगदा मुद्रा चाकारतः स्मृता //
309.m:
Stretching out three [fingers] on each hand, it is proclaimed as the Vajra-mudrā;
[Footnote]
1 [Variant reading:] "prasāryā ceti" in manuscript ṭa. / [Page 139]
The staff, sword, discus, and mace mudrās are taught according to their forms.

309.s:
aṅguṣṭhenākramet trīṇi triśūlañcordhvato bhavet /
ekā tu madhyamordhvā tu śaktireva vidhīyate //
309.d:
अङ्गुष्ठेनाक्रमेत् त्रीणि त्रिशूलञ्चोर्ध्वतो भवेत् /
एका तु मध्यमोर्ध्वा तु शक्तिरेव विधीयते //
309.m:
With the thumb one should press down three [fingers], and the trident [mudrā] points upward.
When only the middle finger is upright, it is designated as the śakti [mudrā].

309.s:
śarañca varadañcāpaṃ pāśaṃ bhārañca ghaṇṭayā /
śaṅkhamaṅkuśamabhayaṃ padmamaṣṭa ca viṃśatiḥ //
309.d:
शरञ्च वरदञ्चापं पाशं भारञ्च घण्टया /
शङ्खमङ्कुशमभयं पद्ममष्ट च विंशतिः //
309.m:
The arrow, the boon-bestower, the bow, the noose, the load, with the bell,
the conch, the goad, the fearlessness, [and] the lotus make twenty-eight [mudrās].

309.s:
mohaṇī mokṣaṇī caiva jvālinī cāmṛtābhayā /
praṇītāḥ pañcamudrāstu pūjāhome ca yojayet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāmantrādirnāma navādhikatriśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha daśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tvaritāmūlamantrādiḥ
309.d:
मोहणी मोक्षणी चैव ज्वालिनी चामृताभया /
प्रणीताः पञ्चमुद्रास्तु पूजाहोमे च योजयेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्वरितामन्त्रादिर्नाम नवाधिकत्रिशततमो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ दशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
त्वरितामूलमन्त्रादिः
309.m:
Mohaṇī, Mokṣaṇī, Jvālinī, and Amṛtābhayā
are prescribed as five mudrās; one should employ them in worship and fire oblation.
Thus in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the three hundred and ninth chapter, named 'The Mantras and Ritual Gestures of Tvaritā'.
Now the three hundred and tenth chapter.
The Root Mantra of Tvaritā and Related Rites

310.s:
agnir uvāca
dīkṣādi vakṣye vinyasya siṃhavajrākule 'bjake /
he 2 huti vajradanta puru 2 lulu 2 garja 2 iha siṃhāsanāya namaḥ
tiryagūrdhvagatā rekhāś catvāraś catvāraś caturo bhavet //
310.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
दीक्षादि वक्ष्ये विन्यस्य सिंहवज्राकुले ऽब्जके /
हे 2 हुति वज्रदन्त पुरु 2 लुलु 2 गर्ज 2 इह सिंहासनाय नमः
तिर्यगूर्ध्वगता रेखाश् चत्वारश् चत्वारश् चतुरो भवेत् //
310.m:
Agni said:
I shall describe initiation and other rites after laying down [the diagram] on a lotus filled with lions and vajras.
'He he huti vajradanta puru puru lulu lulu garja garja, here, obeisance to the lion-throne.'
There should be four transverse and four upward-running lines, forming a square.

310.s:
navabhāgavibhāgena koṣṭhakān kārayedbudhaḥ /
grāhyā diśāgatāḥ koṣṭhā vidiśāsu vināśayet //
310.d:
नवभागविभागेन कोष्ठकान् कारयेद्बुधः /
ग्राह्या दिशागताः कोष्ठा विदिशासु विनाशयेत् //
310.m:
The wise man should make compartments divided into nine parts.
The compartments positioned in the cardinal directions should be taken; those in the intermediate directions one should eliminate.

310.s:
vāhye vai koṣṭhakoṇeṣu vāhyarekhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam /
vāhyakoṣṭhasya vāhye tu madhye yāvat samānayet //
310.d:
वाह्ये वै कोष्ठकोणेषु वाह्यरेखाष्टकं स्मृतम् /
वाह्यकोष्ठस्य वाह्ये तु मध्ये यावत् समानयेत् //
310.m:
Outside, at the corners of the compartments, eight outer lines are taught.
Outside of the outer compartment, one should bring them into the middle.

310.s:
vajrasya madhyamaṃ śṛṅgaṃ vāhyarekhā dvidhārdhataḥ /
vāhyarekhā bhavedvakrā dvibhaṅgā kārayedbudhaḥ //
:p 140
310.d:
वज्रस्य मध्यमं शृङ्गं वाह्यरेखा द्विधार्धतः /
वाह्यरेखा भवेद्वक्रा द्विभङ्गा कारयेद्बुधः //
:प् 140
310.m:
The central prong of the vajra [is formed by] dividing the outer line in half.
The outer line should be curved; the wise man should make it double-bent.
:p 140

310.s:
madhyakoṣṭhaṃ bhavetpadmaṃ pītakarṇikamujjvalam /
kṛṣṇena rajasā likhya kuliśāsiśitordhatā //
310.d:
मध्यकोष्ठं भवेत्पद्मं पीतकर्णिकमुज्ज्वलम् /
कृष्णेन रजसा लिख्य कुलिशासिशितोर्धता //
310.m:
The central compartment should be a lotus with a radiant yellow pericarp.
Drawing with black powder, the tips of the thunderbolts and swords point upward.

310.s:
vāhyataś caturasrantu vajrasampuṭalāñchitam /
dvāre pradāpayenmantrī caturo vajrasampuṭān //
310.d:
वाह्यतश् चतुरस्रन्तु वज्रसम्पुटलाञ्छितम् /
द्वारे प्रदापयेन्मन्त्री चतुरो वज्रसम्पुटान् //
310.m:
Outside, however, there is a square marked with vajra enclosures.
At the doorway the mantrin should place four vajra enclosures.

310.s:
padmanāma bhavedvāmavīthī caiva samā bhavet /
garbhaṃ raktaṃ keśarāṇi maṇḍale dīkṣitāḥ striyaḥ //
310.d:
पद्मनाम भवेद्वामवीथी चैव समा भवेत् /
गर्भं रक्तं केशराणि मण्डले दीक्षिताः स्त्रियः //
310.m:
The left aisle should be named the lotus aisle, and it should be uniform.
The centre is red, along with the filaments; women initiated in the maṇḍala

310.s:
jayecca pararāṣṭrāṇi kṣipraṃ rājyamavāpnuyāt /
mūrtiṃ praṇavasandīptāṃ hūṃkāreṇa niyojayet //
310.d:
जयेच्च परराष्ट्राणि क्षिप्रं राज्यमवाप्नुयात् /
मूर्तिं प्रणवसन्दीप्तां हूंकारेण नियोजयेत् //
310.m:
conquer hostile realms and swiftly attain kingdom.
One should unite the icon, radiant with the praṇava, with the syllable Hūṃ.

310.s:
mūlavidyāṃ samuccārya marudvyomagatāṃ dvija /
prathamena punaś caiva karṇikāyāṃ prapūjayet //
310.d:
मूलविद्यां समुच्चार्य मरुद्व्योमगतां द्विज /
प्रथमेन पुनश् चैव कर्णिकायां प्रपूजयेत् //
310.m:
Uttering the root vidyā situated in air and ether, O twice-born,
one should worship it on the pericarp once again with the first [seed-syllable].

310.s:
evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pūjya ekaikaṃ vījamāditaḥ /
dalamadhye tu vidyāṅgā āgneyyāṃ pañca nairṛtam(1) //
310.d:
एवं प्रदक्षिणं पूज्य एकैकं वीजमादितः /
दलमध्ये तु विद्याङ्गा आग्नेय्यां पञ्च नैरृतम्(1) //
310.m:
Thus, circumambulating and worshipping each seed-syllable from the beginning,
the limbs of the vidyā are in the middle of the petals, five from the south-east to the south-west.

310.s:
madhye netraṃ diśāstrañca guhyakāṅge tu rakṣaṇam /
hutayaḥ keśarasthāstu vāmadakṣiṇapārśvataḥ //
310.d:
मध्ये नेत्रं दिशास्त्रञ्च गुह्यकाङ्गे तु रक्षणम् /
हुतयः केशरस्थास्तु वामदक्षिणपार्श्वतः //
310.m:
In the centre is the eye, the weapon in the directions, and the protection on the secret limbs.
The oblations stand on the filaments on the left and right sides.

310.s:
pañca pañca prapūjyāstu svaiḥ svair mantraiḥ prapūjayet /
lokapālānnyasedaṣṭau vāhyato garbhamaṇḍale //
310.d:
पञ्च पञ्च प्रपूज्यास्तु स्वैः स्वैर् मन्त्रैः प्रपूजयेत् /
लोकपालान्न्यसेदष्टौ वाह्यतो गर्भमण्डले //
310.m:
Five by five are to be worshipped; one should worship each with its own mantra.
One should place the eight guardians of the worlds outside, in the central maṇḍala.

310.s:
varṇāntamagnimārūṭaṃ ṣaṣṭhasvaravibheditaṃ(2) /
pañcadaśena cākrāntaṃ svaiḥ svair nāmabhi yojayet(3) //
310.d:
वर्णान्तमग्निमारूटं षष्ठस्वरविभेदितं(2) /
पञ्चदशेन चाक्रान्तं स्वैः स्वैर् नामभि योजयेत्(3) //
310.m:
Mounted on the fire-consonant, followed by the sixth vowel,
and enveloped by the fifteenth, one should combine them with their respective names.

310.s:
śīghraṃ(4) siṃhe karṇikāyāṃ yajed gandhādibhiḥ śriye(5) /
:n
1 āgneyāvannairṛtamiti ña..
2 jyeṣṭhasvaravibhūṣitamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 nāmabhiryojayedityayaṃ pāṭhaḥ samīcīno bhavitumarhati
4 nīleti ña..
5 śriyamiti ña..
:p 141
aṣṭābhir veṣṭayet kummair(?) mantrāṣṭaśatamantritaiḥ //
310.d:
शीघ्रं(4) सिंहे कर्णिकायां यजेद् गन्धादिभिः श्रिये(5) /
:न्
1 आग्नेयावन्नैरृतमिति ञ..
2 ज्येष्ठस्वरविभूषितमिति ख.. , छ.. च
3 नामभिर्योजयेदित्ययं पाठः समीचीनो भवितुमर्हति
4 नीलेति ञ..
5 श्रियमिति ञ..
:प् 141
अष्टाभिर् वेष्टयेत् कुम्मैर्(?) मन्त्राष्टशतमन्त्रितैः //
310.m:
One should swiftly worship upon the lion in the pericarp with perfumes and other offerings for prosperity.
:n
1 'āgneyāvannairṛtam' in manuscript ña.
2 'jyeṣṭhasvaravibhūṣitam' in manuscripts kha. and cha.
3 'nāmabhiryojayet' would be the correct reading.
4 'nīla' in manuscript ña.
5 'śriyam' in manuscript ña.
:p 141
One should surround it with eight jars consecrated with one hundred and eight recitations of the mantra.

310.s:
mantramaṣṭasahasrantu japtvāṅgānāṃ daśāṃśakam /
tomaṃ kuryādagnikuṇḍe vahnimantreṇa cālayet //
310.d:
मन्त्रमष्टसहस्रन्तु जप्त्वाङ्गानां दशांशकम् /
तोमं कुर्यादग्निकुण्डे वह्निमन्त्रेण चालयेत् //
310.m:
Having recited the mantra eight thousand times, [and] a tenth of that for the limb mantras,
one should perform a fire oblation in the fire-pit and kindle it with the fire-mantra.

310.s:
nikṣiped hṛdayenāgniṃ śaktiṃ madhye 'gnigāṃ smaret /
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ jātakarma ca homayet //
310.d:
निक्षिपेद् हृदयेनाग्निं शक्तिं मध्ये ऽग्निगां स्मरेत् /
गर्भाधानं पुंसवनं जातकर्म च होमयेत् //
310.m:
One should deposit the fire with the heart mantra, meditating on the Śakti residing within the fire.
One should offer oblations for the conception, the rite for procuring a male child, and the birth-rite.

310.s:
hṛdayena śataṃ hy ekaṃ guhyekaṃ guhyāṅge janayecchikhim /
pūrṇāhutyā tu vidyāyāḥ śivāgnirjvalito bhavet //
310.d:
हृदयेन शतं ह्य् एकं गुह्येकं गुह्याङ्गे जनयेच्छिखिम् /
पूर्णाहुत्या तु विद्यायाः शिवाग्निर्ज्वलितो भवेत् //
310.m:
With the heart mantra, one hundred [oblations generate the fire]; one should produce the flame in the secret limb.
Through the full oblation of the vidyā, the fire of Śiva becomes ignited.

310.s:
homayemmūlamantreṇa śatañcāṅgaṃ daśāṃśataḥ /
nivedayettato devyāstataḥ śiṣyaṃ praveśayet //
310.d:
होमयेम्मूलमन्त्रेण शतञ्चाङ्गं दशांशतः /
निवेदयेत्ततो देव्यास्ततः शिष्यं प्रवेशयेत् //
310.m:
One should offer oblations with the root mantra one hundred times, and one tenth [of that] for each limb.
One should then make an offering to the Goddess, and then lead the disciple inside.

310.s:
astreṇa tāḍanaṃ kṛtvā guhyāṅgāni tato nyaset /
vidyāṅgaiś caiva sannaddhaṃ vidyāṅgeṣu niyojayet //
310.d:
अस्त्रेण ताडनं कृत्वा गुह्याङ्गानि ततो न्यसेत् /
विद्याङ्गैश् चैव सन्नद्धं विद्याङ्गेषु नियोजयेत् //
310.m:
Striking [the disciple] with the weapon mantra, one should then deposit the secret limbs.
Equipped with the limbs of the vidyā, one should unite him to the limbs of the vidyā.

310.s:
puṣpaṃ kṣipāyayecchiṣyamānayedagnikuṇḍakam /
yavair dvānyaistilair ājyair mūlavidyāśataṃ hunet //
310.d:
पुष्पं क्षिपाययेच्छिष्यमानयेदग्निकुण्डकम् /
यवैर् द्वान्यैस्तिलैर् आज्यैर् मूलविद्याशतं हुनेत् //
310.m:
One should make the disciple cast a flower and lead him to the fire-pit.
With barley, grains, sesame, and clarified butter, one should offer a hundred oblations with the root vidyā.

310.s:
sthāvaratvaṃ purā homaṃ sarīsṛpamataḥ paraṃ /
pakṣimṛgapaśutvañca mānuṣaṃ brāhmameva ca //
310.d:
स्थावरत्वं पुरा होमं सरीसृपमतः परं /
पक्षिमृगपशुत्वञ्च मानुषं ब्राह्ममेव च //
310.m:
First an oblation for the plant state, after that for the reptile state,
and the states of bird, wild animal, domestic beast, human, and the state of Brahmā,

310.s:
viṣṇutvañcaiva rudratvamante pūrṇāhutirbhavet /
ekayā caiva hy āhtyā śiṣyaḥ syāddīkṣito bhavet //
310.d:
विष्णुत्वञ्चैव रुद्रत्वमन्ते पूर्णाहुतिर्भवेत् /
एकया चैव ह्य् आह्त्या शिष्यः स्याद्दीक्षितो भवेत् //
310.m:
and the state of Viṣṇu, and the state of Rudra; at the end there should be a full oblation.
By that single oblation, the disciple becomes initiated.

310.s:
adhikāro bhavedevaṃ śṛṇu mokṣamataḥ param /
sumerustho yadā mantrī sadāśivapade sthitaḥ //
310.d:
अधिकारो भवेदेवं शृणु मोक्षमतः परम् /
सुमेरुस्थो यदा मन्त्री सदाशिवपदे स्थितः //
310.m:
In this way qualification is attained. Hear now concerning liberation.
When the mantrin stands upon Mount Meru, established in the state of Sadāśiva,

310.s:
pare ca homayet svastho 'karmakarmaśatān daśa /
pūrṇāhutyā tu tadyogī dharmādharmair na lipyate //
310.d:
परे च होमयेत् स्वस्थो ऽकर्मकर्मशतान् दश /
पूर्णाहुत्या तु तद्योगी धर्माधर्मैर् न लिप्यते //
310.m:
and, composed, offers in the Supreme one thousand non-action-actions,
by that full oblation the yogin is not smeared by merit or demerit.

310.s:
mokṣaṃ yāti paraṃsthānaṃ yadgatvā na nivartate /
yathā jale jalaṃ kṣiptaṃ jalaṃ dehī śiras tathā //
:p 142
310.d:
मोक्षं याति परंस्थानं यद्गत्वा न निवर्तते /
यथा जले जलं क्षिप्तं जलं देही शिरस् तथा //
:प् 142
310.m:
He goes to liberation, the supreme abode from which, having gone, one does not return.
Just as water poured into water is water, so is the embodied soul in the Supreme.
:p 142

310.s:
kumbhaiḥ kuryāccābhiṣekaṃ jayarājyādisarvabhāk /
kumārī brāhmaṇī pūjyā gurvāderdakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
310.d:
कुम्भैः कुर्याच्चाभिषेकं जयराज्यादिसर्वभाक् /
कुमारी ब्राह्मणी पूज्या गुर्वादेर्दक्षिणां ददेत् //
310.m:
He should perform the consecration by aspersion with jars, enjoying victory, kingship, and all things.
A young virgin and a Brahmin woman should be worshipped, and he should give a sacrificial fee to the guru and others.

310.s:
yajet sahasramekantu pūjāṃ kṛtvā dine dine /
tilājyapurahomena(1) devī śrīḥ kāmadā bhavet //
310.d:
यजेत् सहस्रमेकन्तु पूजां कृत्वा दिने दिने /
तिलाज्यपुरहोमेन(1) देवी श्रीः कामदा भवेत् //
310.m:
Performing worship day after day, one should sacrifice one thousand times.
Through oblations of sesame, clarified butter, and bdellium, the goddess Śrī becomes the granter of desires.

310.s:
dadāti vipulān bhogān yadanyacca samīhate /
japtvā hy akṣaralakṣantu nidhānādhipatirbhavet //
310.d:
ददाति विपुलान् भोगान् यदन्यच्च समीहते /
जप्त्वा ह्य् अक्षरलक्षन्तु निधानाधिपतिर्भवेत् //
310.m:
She grants abundant worldly enjoyments and whatever else one desires.
By reciting one hundred thousand syllables, one becomes the master of hidden treasures.

310.s:
dviguṇena bhavedrājyaṃ triguṇena ca yakṣiṇī /
caturguṇena brahmatvaṃ tato viṣṇupadaṃ bhavet //
310.d:
द्विगुणेन भवेद्राज्यं त्रिगुणेन च यक्षिणी /
चतुर्गुणेन ब्रह्मत्वं ततो विष्णुपदं भवेत् //
310.m:
With twice that number kingship is attained; with three times, a yakṣiṇī;
with four times, the state of Brahmā; then the station of Viṣṇu.

310.s:
ṣaḍguṇena mahāsiddhir lakṣeṇaikena pāpahā /
daśa japtvā dehaśuddhyai tīrthasnānaphalaṃ śatāt //
310.d:
षड्गुणेन महासिद्धिर् लक्षेणैकेन पापहा /
दश जप्त्वा देहशुद्ध्यै तीर्थस्नानफलं शतात् //
310.m:
With six times, great supernatural power; with a single hundred thousand, one destroys sins.
Reciting ten times for purification of the body; from a hundred times comes the fruit of bathing in a sacred ford.

310.s:
paṭe vā pratimāyāṃ vā śīghrāṃ vai sthaṇḍile yajet /
śataṃ sahasramayutaṃ jape home prakīrtitam //
310.d:
पटे वा प्रतिमायां वा शीघ्रां वै स्थण्डिले यजेत् /
शतं सहस्रमयुतं जपे होमे प्रकीर्तितम् //
310.m:
On a cloth, or on an image, or on a raised ground one should worship Tvaritā.
A hundred, a thousand, and ten thousand are proclaimed for recitation and fire oblation.

310.s:
evaṃ vidhānato japtvā lakṣamekantu homayet /
mahiṣājameṣamāṃsena narajena pureṇa(2) vā //
310.d:
एवं विधानतो जप्त्वा लक्षमेकन्तु होमयेत् /
महिषाजमेषमांसेन नरजेन पुरेण(2) वा //
310.m:
Having recited thus according to rule, one should offer one hundred thousand oblations
with the meat of a buffalo, goat, or ram, or of a human, or with bdellium,

310.s:
tilair yavais tathā lājair vrīhigodhūmakāmrakaiḥ /
śrīphalair ājyasaṃyuktair homayitvā vratañcaret //
310.d:
तिलैर् यवैस् तथा लाजैर् व्रीहिगोधूमकाम्रकैः /
श्रीफलैर् आज्यसंयुक्तैर् होमयित्वा व्रतञ्चरेत् //
310.m:
with sesame, barley, and parched grain, rice, wheat, mangoes,
and bilva fruits mixed with clarified butter; having made the fire oblation, one should observe the votive observance.

310.s:
ardharātreṣu sannaddhaḥ khaḍgacāpaśarādimān /
ekavāsā vicitreṇa raktapītāsitena vā //
310.d:
अर्धरात्रेषु सन्नद्धः खड्गचापशरादिमान् /
एकवासा विचित्रेण रक्तपीतासितेन वा //
310.m:
Armed at midnight, bearing sword, bow, arrows, and the like,
clothed in a single garment that is variegated, or red, yellow, black,

310.s:
nīlena vātha vastreṇa devīṃ tair eva cārcayet /
vrajeddakṣiṇadigbhāgaṃ dvāre dadyādbaliṃ budhaḥ //
:n
1 tilājyaplavahomeneti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 plaveneti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 143
310.d:
नीलेन वाथ वस्त्रेण देवीं तैर् एव चार्चयेत् /
व्रजेद्दक्षिणदिग्भागं द्वारे दद्याद्बलिं बुधः //
:न्
1 तिलाज्यप्लवहोमेनेति ख.. , छ.. च
2 प्लवेनेति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 143
310.m:
or blue, one should worship the Goddess with those very things.
The wise man should go to the southern quarter and offer a bali at the doorway.
:n
1 'tilājyaplavahomena' in manuscripts kha. and cha.
2 'plavena' in manuscripts kha. and cha.
:p 143

310.s:
dūtīmantreṇa dvārādau ekavṛkṣe śmaśānake /
evañca sarvakāmāptirbhuṅkte sarvāṃ mahīṃ nṛpaḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāmūlamantro nāma
daśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś athaikādaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tvaritāvidyā
310.d:
दूतीमन्त्रेण द्वारादौ एकवृक्षे श्मशानके /
एवञ्च सर्वकामाप्तिर्भुङ्क्ते सर्वां महीं नृपः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्वरितामूलमन्त्रो नाम
दशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथैकादशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
त्वरिताविद्या
310.m:
With the messenger-mantra, at a doorway and elsewhere, at a solitary tree, or in a cremation ground,
and thus all desires are attained; the king enjoys the entire earth.
Thus in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the three hundred and tenth chapter, named 'The Root Mantra of Tvaritā'.
Now the three hundred and eleventh chapter.
[Thus ends] the Tvaritā-vidyā.

311.s:
agnir uvāca
vidyāprastāvamākhyāsye dharmakāmādisiddhidam /
navakoṣṭhavibhāgena vidyābhedañca vindati //
311.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
विद्याप्रस्तावमाख्यास्ये धर्मकामादिसिद्धिदम् /
नवकोष्ठविभागेन विद्याभेदञ्च विन्दति //
311.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the permutation scheme of the vidyā, which grants the attainment of righteousness, pleasure, and the rest; / and one finds the varieties of the vidyā by the division of nine squares.

311.s:
anulomavilomena samastavyastayogataḥ /
karṇāvikarṇayogena ata ūrdhvaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ //
311.d:
अनुलोमविलोमेन समस्तव्यस्तयोगतः /
कर्णाविकर्णयोगेन अत ऊर्ध्वं विभागशः //
311.m: In forward and reverse order, through complete and separate combinations, / through diagonal and non-diagonal arrangements, and further upward according to divisions,

311.s:
tritrikeṇa ca yogena devyā sannaddhavigrahaḥ /
jānāti siddhidānmantrān prastāvānnirgatān bahūn //
311.d:
त्रित्रिकेण च योगेन देव्या सन्नद्धविग्रहः /
जानाति सिद्धिदान्मन्त्रान् प्रस्तावान्निर्गतान् बहून् //
311.m: And by combinations of groups of three, his body armored with the goddess, / he knows the many siddhi-bestowing mantras that have issued from the permutation table.

311.s:
śāstre śāstre smṛtā mantrāḥ prayogāstatra durlabhāḥ /
guruḥ syāt prathamo varṇaḥ pūrvedyurna ca varṇyate //
311.d:
शास्त्रे शास्त्रे स्मृता मन्त्राः प्रयोगास्तत्र दुर्लभाः /
गुरुः स्यात् प्रथमो वर्णः पूर्वेद्युर्न च वर्ण्यते //
311.m: Mantras are remembered in scripture after scripture, but their practical applications are difficult to obtain therein. / The first syllable should be a guru; it was not described previously.

311.s:
prastāve tatra caikārṇā dvyarṇāstryarṇādayo 'bhavan /
tiryagūrdhvagatā rekhāś caturaś caturo bhajet //
311.d:
प्रस्तावे तत्र चैकार्णा द्व्यर्णास्त्र्यर्णादयो ऽभवन् /
तिर्यगूर्ध्वगता रेखाश् चतुरश् चतुरो भजेत् //
311.m: In that permutation scheme, mantras of one syllable, two syllables, three syllables, and so forth arose. / One should draw lines running across and upwards, four and four;

311.s:
nava koṣṭhā bhavantyevaṃ madhyadeśe tathā imān /
pradakṣiṇena saṃsthāpya prastāvaṃ bhedayettataḥ //
311.d:
नव कोष्ठा भवन्त्येवं मध्यदेशे तथा इमान् /
प्रदक्षिणेन संस्थाप्य प्रस्तावं भेदयेत्ततः //
311.m: Thus nine squares are formed; likewise, having arranged these / in the central region in a clockwise direction, one should then divide the permutation scheme.

311.s:
prastāvakramayogena prastāvaṃ yastu vindati /
karamuṣṭisthitāstasya sādhakasya hi siddhayaḥ //
:p 144
311.d:
प्रस्तावक्रमयोगेन प्रस्तावं यस्तु विन्दति /
करमुष्टिस्थितास्तस्य साधकस्य हि सिद्धयः //
:प् 144
311.m:
He who knows the permutation table according to the method of permutation /—for that practitioner, attainments indeed reside in his clenched fist.
[Page 144]

311.s:
trailokyaṃ pādamūle syānnavakhaṇḍāṃ bhuvaṃ labhet /
kapāle tu samālikhya śivatattvaṃ samantataḥ //
311.d:
त्रैलोक्यं पादमूले स्यान्नवखण्डां भुवं लभेत् /
कपाले तु समालिख्य शिवतत्त्वं समन्ततः //
311.m: The three worlds will be at his feet; he shall obtain the earth of nine continents. / Having drawn the principle of Śiva all around upon a skull,

311.s:
śmaśānakarpaṭe vātha vāhyaṃ niṣkramya mantravit /
tasya madhye likhennāma karṇikopari saṃsthitam //
311.d:
श्मशानकर्पटे वाथ वाह्यं निष्क्रम्य मन्त्रवित् /
तस्य मध्ये लिखेन्नाम कर्णिकोपरि संस्थितम् //
311.m: Or on a shroud from a cremation ground, the knower of mantras, having gone outside, / should write the name in its center, situated upon the pericarp.

311.s:
tāpayetkhādirāṅgārair bhūrjamākramya pādayoḥ /
saptāhādānayet sarvaṃ trelokyaṃ sacarācaram //
311.d:
तापयेत्खादिराङ्गारैर् भूर्जमाक्रम्य पादयोः /
सप्ताहादानयेत् सर्वं त्रेलोक्यं सचराचरम् //
311.m: Pressing the birch-bark under his feet, he should heat it with khadira embers; / within seven days he can subjugate everything, the three worlds with all that moves and is still.

311.s:
vajrasampuṭagarbhe tu dvādaśāre tu lekhayet /
madhye garbhagataṃ nāma sadāśivavidarbhitam //
311.d:
वज्रसम्पुटगर्भे तु द्वादशारे तु लेखयेत् /
मध्ये गर्भगतं नाम सदाशिवविदर्भितम् //
311.m: Within the womb of a vajra casing, one should write it upon a twelve-spoked [diagram], / the name placed inside the center, interwoven with the mantra of Sadāśiva.

311.s:
kuḍye(1) phalakake vātha śilāpaṭṭe haridrayā /
mukhastambhaṃ gatistambhaṃ sainyastambhantu jāyate //
311.d:
कुड्ये(1) फलकके वाथ शिलापट्टे हरिद्रया /
मुखस्तम्भं गतिस्तम्भं सैन्यस्तम्भन्तु जायते //
311.m: [Written] with turmeric on a wall, or on a wooden tablet, or on a stone slab, / immobilization of the mouth, immobilization of movement, and immobilization of the army occurs.

311.s:
viṣaraktena saṃlikhya śmaśāne karpare budhaḥ /
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ daṇḍamākrāntaṃ samantācchaktiyojitam //
311.d:
विषरक्तेन संलिख्य श्मशाने कर्परे बुधः /
षट्कोणं दण्डमाक्रान्तं समन्ताच्छक्तियोजितम् //
311.m: The wise one, having drawn with poison and blood upon a skull-cup in a cremation ground / a hexagon traversed by a staff, united on all sides with Śakti,

311.s:
mārayedacirādeṣa śmaśāne nihataṃ ripuṃ /
chedaṃ karoti rāṣṭrasya cakramadhye nyasedripuṃ //
311.d:
मारयेदचिरादेष श्मशाने निहतं रिपुं /
छेदं करोति राष्ट्रस्य चक्रमध्ये न्यसेद्रिपुं //
311.m: Shall swiftly slay the enemy who has been struck down in the cremation ground. / He causes the ruin of a kingdom; he should deposit the enemy within the center of the cakra.

311.s:
cakradhārāṅgatāṃ śaktiṃ ripunāmnā ripuṃ haret /
tārkṣyeṇaiva tu vījena khaḍgamadhye tu lekhayet //
311.d:
चक्रधाराङ्गतां शक्तिं रिपुनाम्ना रिपुं हरेत् /
तार्क्ष्येणैव तु वीजेन खड्गमध्ये तु लेखयेत् //
311.m: With the Śakti placed on the rim of the wheel, he should destroy the enemy by means of the enemy's name. / One should write [it] within a sword with the seed-syllable of Garuḍa,

311.s:
vidarbharipunāmātha śmaśānāṅgāralekhitam /
saptāhātsādhayeddeśaṃ tāḍayet pretabhasmanā //
311.d:
विदर्भरिपुनामाथ श्मशानाङ्गारलेखितम् /
सप्ताहात्साधयेद्देशं ताडयेत् प्रेतभस्मना //
311.m: Interwoven with the enemy's name, written with cremation-ground charcoal; / within seven days he will subjugate the region; he should strike it with ashes of a corpse.

311.s:
bhedane chedane caiva māraṇeṣu śivo bhavet /
tārakaṃ netramuddiṣṭaṃ śāntipuṣṭau niyojayet //
311.d:
भेदने छेदने चैव मारणेषु शिवो भवेत् /
तारकं नेत्रमुद्दिष्टं शान्तिपुष्टौ नियोजयेत् //
311.m: In sowing discord, cleaving, and lethal rites, he becomes Śiva. / The eye is taught to be Tāraka; one should employ it for pacification and nourishment.

311.s:
dahanādiprayogoyaṃ śākinīñcaiva karpayet /
madhyādivāruṇīṃ yāvadvakratuṇḍasamanvitaḥ(2) //
:n
1 kuṇḍa iti ka..
2 vajratuṇdasamanvita iti ṭa..
:p 145
311.d:
दहनादिप्रयोगोयं शाकिनीञ्चैव कर्पयेत् /
मध्यादिवारुणीं यावद्वक्रतुण्डसमन्वितः(2) //
:न्
1 कुण्ड इति क..
2 वज्रतुण्दसमन्वित इति ट..
:प् 145
311.m:
This application of burning and the like affects the śākinī. / From the center up to the western direction, endowed with Vakratuṇḍa,
[Footnote]
1 [Variant reading:] "kuṇḍe" in manuscript ka.
2 [Variant reading:] "vajratuṇḍasamanvitaḥ" in manuscript ṭa. / [Page 145]

311.s:
kuṣṭādyā vyādhayo ye tu nāśayettānna saṃśayaḥ /
madhyādiuttarāntantu karālībandhanājjapet //
311.d:
कुष्टाद्या व्याधयो ये तु नाशयेत्तान्न संशयः /
मध्यादिउत्तरान्तन्तु करालीबन्धनाज्जपेत् //
311.m: He will destroy whatever diseases there are, such as leprosy, without a doubt. / From the center to the north, one should recite from the binding of Karālī.

311.s:
rakṣayedātmano vidyāṃ prativādī yadā śivaḥ /
vāruṇyādi tato nyasya jvarakāśavināśanam //
311.d:
रक्षयेदात्मनो विद्यां प्रतिवादी यदा शिवः /
वारुण्यादि ततो न्यस्य ज्वरकाशविनाशनम् //
311.m: One should protect one's own vidyā when the opponent is Śiva. / Then, depositing from the west onward, there is the destruction of fever and cough.

311.s:
saumyādi madhyamāntantu gurutvaṃ jāyate vaṭe /
pūrvādi madhyamāntantu laghutvaṃ kurute kṣaṇāt //
311.d:
सौम्यादि मध्यमान्तन्तु गुरुत्वं जायते वटे /
पूर्वादि मध्यमान्तन्तु लघुत्वं कुरुते क्षणात् //
311.m: From the north to the center, heaviness occurs in a banyan tree; / from the east to the center, it produces lightness in an instant.

311.s:
bhūrje rocanayā likhya etadvajrākulaṃ puram /
kramasthair mantravījaistu rakṣāṃ deheṣu kārayet //
311.d:
भूर्जे रोचनया लिख्य एतद्वज्राकुलं पुरम् /
क्रमस्थैर् मन्त्रवीजैस्तु रक्षां देहेषु कारयेत् //
311.m: Having written on birch-bark with yellow rocanā this city filled with vajras, / one should effect protection upon bodies with the mantra seed-syllables placed in sequence.

311.s:
veṣṭitā bhāvahemnā ca(1) rakṣeyaṃ mṛtyunāśinī /
vighnapāpāridamanī saubhāgyāyuḥpradā dhṛtā //
311.d:
वेष्टिता भावहेम्ना च(1) रक्षेयं मृत्युनाशिनी /
विघ्नपापारिदमनी सौभाग्यायुःप्रदा धृता //
311.m: Wrapped in gold, this protective amulet destroys death; / worn, it subdues obstacles, sins, and enemies, and grants good fortune and long life.

311.s:
dyūte reṇe ca jayadā śakrasainye na saṃśayaḥ /
bandhyānāṃ putradā hy eṣā cintāmaṇirivāparā //
311.d:
द्यूते रेणे च जयदा शक्रसैन्ये न संशयः /
बन्ध्यानां पुत्रदा ह्य् एषा चिन्तामणिरिवापरा //
311.m: It grants victory in gambling, in battle, and against Indra's army, without a doubt; / it gives sons to barren women, indeed like another wish-fulfilling jewel.

311.s:
sādhayet pararāṣṭrāṇi rājyañca pṛthivīṃ jayet /
phaṭ strīṃ kṣeṃ hūṃ lakṣajapyādyakṣādirvaśago bhavet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritāvidyā nāmaikādaśādhikatriśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nānāmantrāḥ
311.d:
साधयेत् परराष्ट्राणि राज्यञ्च पृथिवीं जयेत् /
फट् स्त्रीं क्षें हूं लक्षजप्याद्यक्षादिर्वशगो भवेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्वरिताविद्या नामैकादशाधिकत्रिशततमो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ द्वादशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
नानामन्त्राः
311.m:
One can conquer foreign kingdoms, gain royalty, and conquer the earth. / From a hundred thousand recitations of “phaṭ strīṃ kṣeṃ hūṃ”, yakṣas and the rest become subject to one's will.
Thus ends the three hundred and eleventh chapter in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, entitled “The Lore of Tvaritā”.
Now, the three hundred and twelfth chapter.
Various Mantras

312.s:
agnir uvāca
oṃ vināyakārcanaṃ vakṣye yajedādhāraśaktikam /
dharmādyaṣṭakakandañca nālaṃ padmañca karṇikām //
:n
1 tārahemnā ceti kha..
:p 146
312.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
ओं विनायकार्चनं वक्ष्ये यजेदाधारशक्तिकम् /
धर्माद्यष्टककन्दञ्च नालं पद्मञ्च कर्णिकाम् //
:न्
1 तारहेम्ना चेति ख..
:प् 146
312.m:
Agni said: / Om. I shall declare the worship of Vināyaka. One should worship the Support Power, / the bulb consisting of the eight beginning with virtue, the stem, the lotus, and the pericarp.
[Footnote]
[Variant: tārahemnā ca] / p. 146

312.s:
keśaraṃ trigunaṃ padmaṃ tīvrañca jvalinīṃ yajet /
nandāñca suyaśāñcogrāṃ tejovatīṃ vindhyavāsinīṃ(1) //
312.d:
केशरं त्रिगुनं पद्मं तीव्रञ्च ज्वलिनीं यजेत् /
नन्दाञ्च सुयशाञ्चोग्रां तेजोवतीं विन्ध्यवासिनीं(1) //
312.m: One should worship the filaments, the three-fold lotus, Tīvrā, and Jvalinī, / and Nandā, Suyaśā, Ugrā, Tejovatī, and Vindhyavāsinī;

312.s:
gaṇamūrtiṃ gaṇapattiṃ hṛdayaṃ syādgaṇaṃ jayaḥ /
ekadantotkaṭaśiraḥśikhāyācalakarṇine //
312.d:
गणमूर्तिं गणपत्तिं हृदयं स्याद्गणं जयः /
एकदन्तोत्कटशिरःशिखायाचलकर्णिने //
312.m: the body of Gaṇa, Gaṇapati, the heart: Gaṇa, Jaya; / for Ekadanta, Utkaṭa, head, crest: to Acalakarṇin;

312.s:
gajavaktrāya kavacaṃ hūṃ phaḍantaṃ tathāṣṭakaṃ /
mahodaro daṇḍahastaḥ pūrvādau madhyato yajet //
312.d:
गजवक्त्राय कवचं हूं फडन्तं तथाष्टकं /
महोदरो दण्डहस्तः पूर्वादौ मध्यतो यजेत् //
312.m: for Gajavaktra, the armour ending in ‘hūṃ phaṭ’, and likewise the eightfold [deities]: / Mahodara holding a staff in hand, worshipping from the east onward, and in the centre.

312.s:
jayo gaṇādhipo gaṇanāyako 'tha gaṇeśvaraḥ /
vakratuṇḍa ekadantotkaṭalambodaro gaja //
312.d:
जयो गणाधिपो गणनायको ऽथ गणेश्वरः /
वक्रतुण्ड एकदन्तोत्कटलम्बोदरो गज //
312.m: Jaya, Gaṇādhipa, Gaṇanāyaka, and Gaṇeśvara, / Vakratuṇḍa, Ekadanta, Utkaṭa, Lambodara, Gaja-

312.s:
vaktro vikaṭānano 'tha hūṃ pūrvo vighnanāśanaḥ /
dhūmravarṇo mahendrādyo vāhye vighneśapūjanam //
312.d:
वक्त्रो विकटाननो ऽथ हूं पूर्वो विघ्ननाशनः /
धूम्रवर्णो महेन्द्राद्यो वाह्ये विघ्नेशपूजनम् //
312.m: vaktra, Vikaṭānana, and Vighnanāśana preceded by ‘hūṃ’, / Dhūmravarṇa, Mahendra, and others. Outside is the worship of the Lord of Obstacles.

312.s:
tripurāpūjanaṃ(2) vakṣye asitāṅgo rurus tathā /
caṇḍaḥ krodhastathonmattaḥ kapālī bhīṣaṇaḥ kramāt //
312.d:
त्रिपुरापूजनं(2) वक्ष्ये असिताङ्गो रुरुस् तथा /
चण्डः क्रोधस्तथोन्मत्तः कपाली भीषणः क्रमात् //
312.m: I shall declare the worship of Tripura: Asitāṅga, and Ruru, / Caṇḍa, Krodha, then Unmatta, Kapālī, Bhīṣaṇa in order,

312.s:
saṃhāro bhairavo brāhmīrmukhyā hrasvāstu bhairabāḥ /
brahmāṇīṣaṇmukhā dīrghā agnyādau vaṭukāḥ kramāt //
312.d:
संहारो भैरवो ब्राह्मीर्मुख्या ह्रस्वास्तु भैरबाः /
ब्रह्माणीषण्मुखा दीर्घा अग्न्यादौ वटुकाः क्रमात् //
312.m: Saṃhāra, and Bhairava. The Bhairavas are short [vowels] with Brāhmī and the others foremost; / Brahmāṇī, Ṣaṇmukhā are long [vowels]. The Vaṭukas are in order from the south-east onward:

312.s:
samayaputro vaṭuko yoginīputrakas tathā /
siddhaputraś ca vaṭukaḥ kulaputraś caturthakaḥ //
312.d:
समयपुत्रो वटुको योगिनीपुत्रकस् तथा /
सिद्धपुत्रश् च वटुकः कुलपुत्रश् चतुर्थकः //
312.m: Samayaputra Vaṭuka, and Yoginīputraka, / Siddhaputra Vaṭuka, and Kulaputra as the fourth,

312.s:
hetukaḥ kṣetrapālaś ca tripurānto dvitīyakaḥ /
agnivetālo 'gnijihvaḥ karālī kālalocanaḥ //
312.d:
हेतुकः क्षेत्रपालश् च त्रिपुरान्तो द्वितीयकः /
अग्निवेतालो ऽग्निजिह्वः कराली काललोचनः //
312.m: Hetuka, Kṣetrapāla, and Tripurānta as the second, / Agnivetāla, Agnijihva, Karālī, Kālalocana,

312.s:
ekapādaś ca bhīmākṣa aiṃ kṣeṃ pretastayāsanaṃ /
aiṃ hrīṃ dvauś ca tripurā padmāsanasamāsthitā //
312.d:
एकपादश् च भीमाक्ष ऐं क्षें प्रेतस्तयासनं /
ऐं ह्रीं द्वौश् च त्रिपुरा पद्मासनसमास्थिता //
312.m: Ekapāda, and Bhīmākṣa. “aiṃ kṣeṃ”—a corpse is their seat. / “aiṃ hrīṃ” and the two Tripurās seated on a lotus throne,

312.s:
vibhratyabhayapustañca vāme varadamālikām /
:n
1 vivāsinīmiti kha..
2 tripurāyajanamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 147
mūlena hṛdayādi syājjālapūrṇañca kāmakam //
312.d:
विभ्रत्यभयपुस्तञ्च वामे वरदमालिकाम् /
:न्
1 विवासिनीमिति ख..
2 त्रिपुरायजनमिति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
:प् 147
मूलेन हृदयादि स्याज्जालपूर्णञ्च कामकम् //
312.m:
bearing the gesture of fearlessness and a book, and in the left hand the boon-granting gesture and a rosary.
[Footnote]
[Variant: vivāsinīm]
[Variant: tripurāyajanam] / p. 147
The heart and other limbs are with the root mantra, and Jālapūrṇa and Kāmaka.

312.s:
gomadhye nāma saṃlikhya cāṣṭapatre ca madhyataḥ /
śmaśānādipaṭe śmaśānāṅgāreṇa vilekhayet //
312.d:
गोमध्ये नाम संलिख्य चाष्टपत्रे च मध्यतः /
श्मशानादिपटे श्मशानाङ्गारेण विलेखयेत् //
312.m: Having written the name in the centre of the cow and in the centre of an eight-petalled lotus, / on a cloth from a cremation ground or the like, one should write it with charcoal from a cremation ground.

312.s:
citāṅgārapiṣṭakena mūrtiṃ dhyātvā tu tasya ca /
kṣiptvodare nīlasūtrair veṣṭya coccāṭhanaṃ bhavet //
312.d:
चिताङ्गारपिष्टकेन मूर्तिं ध्यात्वा तु तस्य च /
क्षिप्त्वोदरे नीलसूत्रैर् वेष्ट्य चोच्चाठनं भवेत् //
312.m: Having meditated upon the form of that [target] with paste of funeral-pyre charcoal, / having placed it inside the belly and bound it with blue threads, eradication takes place.

312.s:
oṃ namo bhagavati jvālāmānini gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte svāhā
yuddhegacchan japanmantraṃ pumān sākṣājjayī bhavet /
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śriyai namaḥ
uttarādau ca ghṛṇinī sūryā pujyā caturdale //
312.d:
ओं नमो भगवति ज्वालामानिनि गृध्रगणपरिवृते स्वाहा
युद्धेगच्छन् जपन्मन्त्रं पुमान् साक्षाज्जयी भवेत् /
ओं श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं श्रियै नमः
उत्तरादौ च घृणिनी सूर्या पुज्या चतुर्दले //
312.m:
“oṃ namo bhagavati jvālāmālini gṛdhragaṇaparivṛte svāhā”. / Reciting the mantra while going into battle, a man becomes visibly victorious.
“oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śriyai namaḥ”.
And on the four petals, Ghṛṇinī and Sūryā are to be worshipped starting from the north,

312.s:
ādityā prabhāvatī ca hemādrimadhurāśrayaḥ /
oṃ hrīṃ gauryai namaḥ
gaurīmantraḥ sarvakaraḥ homāddhyānājjapārcanāt //
312.d:
आदित्या प्रभावती च हेमाद्रिमधुराश्रयः /
ओं ह्रीं गौर्यै नमः
गौरीमन्त्रः सर्वकरः होमाद्ध्यानाज्जपार्चनात् //
312.m:
along with Ādityā, Prabhāvatī, whose resort is sweet like the golden mountain [Meru].
“oṃ hrīṃ gauryai namaḥ”.
The Gaurī mantra accomplishes everything through fire oblation, meditation, recitation, and worship.

312.s:
raktā caturbhujā pāśavaradā dakṣiṇe kare /
aṅkuśābhayayuktāntāṃ prārthya siddhātmanā pumān //
312.d:
रक्ता चतुर्भुजा पाशवरदा दक्षिणे करे /
अङ्कुशाभययुक्तान्तां प्रार्थ्य सिद्धात्मना पुमान् //
312.m: Red, four-armed, giving boons and holding a noose in the right hand, / endowed with a goad and the gesture of fearlessness—having prayed to her with an accomplished soul, a man

312.s:
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ dhīmānna caurāribhayaṃ bhavet /
kruddhaḥ prasādī bhavati yudhi mantrāmbupānataḥ //
312.d:
जीवेद्वर्षशतं धीमान्न चौरारिभयं भवेत् /
क्रुद्धः प्रसादी भवति युधि मन्त्राम्बुपानतः //
312.m: wise will live for a hundred years, and he will have no fear of thieves or enemies. / Even one enraged becomes gracious by drinking water consecrated by the mantra in battle.

312.s:
añjanaṃ tilakaṃ vaśye jihvāgre kavitā bhavet /
tajjapānmaithunaṃ vaśye tajjapādyonivīkṣaṇam //
312.d:
अञ्जनं तिलकं वश्ये जिह्वाग्रे कविता भवेत् /
तज्जपान्मैथुनं वश्ये तज्जपाद्योनिवीक्षणम् //
312.m: Collyrium and forehead-mark for subjugation; poetry will arise on the tip of the tongue; / from its recitation comes subjugation in intercourse; from its recitation comes the beholding of the vulva;

312.s:
sparśādvaśī tilahomātsarvañcaiva tu sidhyati /
saptābhimantritañcānnaṃ bhuñjaṃstasya śriyaḥ sadā //
312.d:
स्पर्शाद्वशी तिलहोमात्सर्वञ्चैव तु सिध्यति /
सप्ताभिमन्त्रितञ्चान्नं भुञ्जंस्तस्य श्रियः सदा //
312.m: from touch comes subjugation; from sesamum fire oblation everything is accomplished; / and eating food consecrated seven times with the mantra, his prosperity is eternal.

312.s:
ardhanārīśarūpo 'yaṃ lakṣmyādivaiṣṇavādikaḥ /
anaṅgarūpā śaktiś ca dvitīyā madanāturā //
312.d:
अर्धनारीशरूपो ऽयं लक्ष्म्यादिवैष्णवादिकः /
अनङ्गरूपा शक्तिश् च द्वितीया मदनातुरा //
312.m: This form of the Half-Female Lord, Vaiṣṇavī and the others beginning with Lakṣmī: / the power Anaṅgarūpā, and second Madanāturā,

312.s:
pavanavegā bhuvanapālā vai savvasiddhidā /
:p 148
anaṅgamadanānaṅgamekhalāntāñcapecchriye //
312.d:
पवनवेगा भुवनपाला वै सव्वसिद्धिदा /
:प् 148
अनङ्गमदनानङ्गमेखलान्ताञ्चपेच्छ्रिये //
312.m:
Pavanavegā, Bhuvanapālā, who indeed grant all accomplishments,
p. 148
ending with Anaṅgamadanā and Anaṅgamekhalā, for prosperity.

312.s:
padmamadhyadaleṣu hrīṃ svarān kādīṃstitaḥ striyāḥ /
ṣaṭkoṇe vā ghaṭe vātha likhitvā syādvaśīkaraṃ //
oṃ hrīṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave oṃ oṃ
312.d:
पद्ममध्यदलेषु ह्रीं स्वरान् कादींस्तितः स्त्रियाः /
षट्कोणे वा घटे वाथ लिखित्वा स्याद्वशीकरं //
ओं ह्रीं छं नित्यक्लिन्ने मदद्रवे ओं ओं
312.m:
Having written “hrīṃ” on the central petals of the lotus, the vowels, and the consonants beginning with ‘ka’ of the woman, / either in a hexagon or on a jar, subjugation is achieved.
“oṃ hrīṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave oṃ oṃ”.

312.s:
mūlamantraḥ ṣaḍaṅgaoyaṃ raktavarṇe trikoṇake /
dravaṇī hlādakāriṇī kṣobhiṇī guruśaktikā //
312.d:
मूलमन्त्रः षडङ्गओयं रक्तवर्णे त्रिकोणके /
द्रवणी ह्लादकारिणी क्षोभिणी गुरुशक्तिका //
312.m: This is the root mantra with six limbs. In a red triangle: / Dravaṇī, Hlādakāriṇī, Kṣobhiṇī, the venerable Power,

312.s:
īśānādau ca madhye tāṃ nityāṃ pāśāṅkuśau tathā /
kapālakalpakataruṃ vīṇā raktā ca tadvatī //
312.d:
ईशानादौ च मध्ये तां नित्यां पाशाङ्कुशौ तथा /
कपालकल्पकतरुं वीणा रक्ता च तद्वती //
312.m: and in the north-east and other directions and in the centre, that Nityā holding a noose and a goad, / likewise a skull-bowl and wish-granting tree, a lute, red and endowed with those.

312.s:
nityābhayā maṅgalā ca navavīrā ca maṅgalā /
durbhagā manonmanī pūjyā drāvā pūrvāditaḥ sthitā //
oṃ hrīṃ anaṅgāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ smarāya
namaḥ
312.d:
नित्याभया मङ्गला च नववीरा च मङ्गला /
दुर्भगा मनोन्मनी पूज्या द्रावा पूर्वादितः स्थिता //
ओं ह्रीं अनङ्गाय नमः ओं ह्रीं ह्रीं स्मराय
नमः
312.m:
Nityā, Abhayā, Maṅgalā, Navavīrā, Maṅgalā, / Durbhagā, Manonmanī are to be worshipped, with Drāvā situated from the east onward.
“oṃ hrīṃ anaṅgāya namaḥ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ smarāya namaḥ”.

312.s:
manmathāya ca mārāya kāmāyaivañca pañcadhā /
kāmāḥ pāśāṅkuśau cāpavāṇāḥ dhyeyāś ca vibhrataḥ //
312.d:
मन्मथाय च माराय कामायैवञ्च पञ्चधा /
कामाः पाशाङ्कुशौ चापवाणाः ध्येयाश् च विभ्रतः //
312.m: To Manmatha, Māra, and Kāma—thus fivefold. / The Kāmās are to be meditated upon holding the noose, the goad, the bow, and arrows.

312.s:
ratiś ca viratiḥ prītirviprītiś ca matirdhṛtiḥ /
vidhṛtiḥ puṣṭirebhiś ca kramāt kāmādikair yutāḥ /
oṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave oṃ oṃ / a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ e ai
o au aṃ aḥ / ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta
tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha kṣa / oṃ chaṃ
nityaklinne madadrave svāhā
ādhāraśaktiṃ padmañca siṃhe devīṃ hṛdādiṣu //
oṃ hrīṃ gauri rudradayite yogeśvari hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāmantrā nāma
dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 149
:ś atha trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tvaritājñānam
agnir uvāca
om hrīṃ hūṃ khe che kṣaḥ strīṃ hrūṃ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭ
tvaritāyainamaḥ
312.d:
रतिश् च विरतिः प्रीतिर्विप्रीतिश् च मतिर्धृतिः /
विधृतिः पुष्टिरेभिश् च क्रमात् कामादिकैर् युताः /
ओं छं नित्यक्लिन्ने मदद्रवे ओं ओं / अ आ इ ई उ ऊ ऋ ॠ ऌ ॡ ए ऐ
ओ औ अं अः / क ख ग घ ङ च छ ज झ ञ ट ठ ड ढ ण त
थ द ध न प फ ब भ म य र ल व श ष स ह क्ष / ओं छं
नित्यक्लिन्ने मदद्रवे स्वाहा
आधारशक्तिं पद्मञ्च सिंहे देवीं हृदादिषु //
ओं ह्रीं गौरि रुद्रदयिते योगेश्वरि हूं फट् स्वाहा
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानामन्त्रा नाम
द्वादशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 149
:श् अथ त्रयोदशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
त्वरिताज्ञानम्
अग्निर् उवाच
ओम् ह्रीं हूं खे छे क्षः स्त्रीं ह्रूं क्षे ह्रीं फट्
त्वरितायैनमः
312.m:
Rati, Virati, Prīti, Viprīti, Mati, Dhṛti, / Vidhṛti, and Puṣṭi—endowed with these deities beginning with Kāma in order. / “oṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave oṃ oṃ / a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ e ai o au aṃ aḥ / ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha kṣa / oṃ chaṃ nityaklinne madadrave svāhā”. / The Support Power, the lotus, and the goddess upon the lion in the heart and other limbs.
“oṃ hrīṃ gauri rudradayite yogeśvari hūṃ phaṭ svāhā”.
Thus ends the three hundred and twelfth chapter in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, entitled “Various Mantras”.
p. 149
Now, the three hundred and thirteenth chapter.
The Knowledge of Tvaritā
Agni said:
“om hrīṃ hūṃ khe che kṣaḥ strīṃ hrūṃ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭ tvaritāyai namaḥ”.

313.s:
tvaritāṃ pūjayennyasya dvibhujāñcāṣṭavāhukāṃ /
ādhāraśaktiṃ padmañca siṃhe devīṃ hṛdādikam //
313.d:
त्वरितां पूजयेन्न्यस्य द्विभुजाञ्चाष्टवाहुकां /
आधारशक्तिं पद्मञ्च सिंहे देवीं हृदादिकम् //
313.m: Having performed deposition, one should worship Tvaritā, two-armed or eight-armed, / the Support Power, the lotus, the goddess upon the lion, the heart and other limbs.

313.s:
pūrvādau gāyatrīṃ yajenmaṇḍale vai praṇītayā /
huṃkārāṃ khecarīṃ caṇḍāṃ chedanīṃ kṣepaṇīṃstriyāḥ //
313.d:
पूर्वादौ गायत्रीं यजेन्मण्डले वै प्रणीतया /
हुंकारां खेचरीं चण्डां छेदनीं क्षेपणींस्त्रियाः //
313.m: One should worship the Gāyatrī from the east onward in the maṇḍala with the praṇīta water: / Huṃkārā, Khecarī, Caṇḍā, Chedanī, Kṣepaṇī, the women,

313.s:
huṃkārāṃ kṣemakārīñca phaṭkārīṃ madhyato yajet /
jayāñca vijayāṃ dvāri kiṅkarañca tadagrataḥ //
313.d:
हुंकारां क्षेमकारीञ्च फट्कारीं मध्यतो यजेत् /
जयाञ्च विजयां द्वारि किङ्करञ्च तदग्रतः //
313.m: Huṃkārā, Kṣemakārī, and Phaṭkārī in the centre; / Jayā and Vijayā at the doorway, and the attendant in front of them.

313.s:
lilaihīmaiś ca sarvāptyai nāmavyāhṛtibhis tathā /
anantāya namaḥ svāhā kulikāya namaḥ svadhā //
313.d:
लिलैहीमैश् च सर्वाप्त्यै नामव्याहृतिभिस् तथा /
अनन्ताय नमः स्वाहा कुलिकाय नमः स्वधा //
313.m: With ‘lilaihīmaiḥ’ for the attainment of everything, and with the utterances of names: / “anantāya namaḥ svāhā”, “kulikāya namaḥ svadhā”,

313.s:
svāhā vāsukirājāya śaṅkhapālāya vauṣaṭ /
takṣakāya vaṣannityaṃ mahāpadmāya vai namaḥ //
313.d:
स्वाहा वासुकिराजाय शङ्खपालाय वौषट् /
तक्षकाय वषन्नित्यं महापद्माय वै नमः //
313.m: “svāhā vāsukirājāya”, “śaṅkhapālāya vauṣaṭ”, / “takṣakāya vaṣaṭ” constantly, “mahāpadmāya vai namaḥ”.

313.s:
svāhā karkoṭanāgāya phaṭ padmāya ca vai namaḥ /
likhennigrahacakrantu ekāśītipadair naraḥ //
313.d:
स्वाहा कर्कोटनागाय फट् पद्माय च वै नमः /
लिखेन्निग्रहचक्रन्तु एकाशीतिपदैर् नरः //
313.m: "Svāhā to the serpent Karkoṭa, phaṭ, and homage to Padma!" / A man should draw the restraining wheel with eighty-one squares.

313.s:
vaste paṭe tarau bhūrje śilāyāṃ yaṣṭikāsu ca /
madhye koṣṭhe sādhyanāma pūrvādau paṭṭikāsu ca //
oṃ hrīṃ kṣūṃ chanda chanda caturaḥ kaṇṭhakān
kālarātrikāṃ
313.d:
वस्ते पटे तरौ भूर्जे शिलायां यष्टिकासु च /
मध्ये कोष्ठे साध्यनाम पूर्वादौ पट्टिकासु च //
ओं ह्रीं क्षूं छन्द छन्द चतुरः कण्ठकान्
कालरात्रिकां
313.m:
On cloth, canvas, a tree, birch bark, a stone, or on sticks, / in the central cell [he should write] the target's name, and in the strips starting from the east:
"Oṃ hrīṃ kṣūṃ cut, cut the four necks, Kālarātrikā!"

313.s:
aiśādāvambupādau ca yamarājyañca vāhyataḥ /
kālīnāravamālī kālīnāmākṣamālinī //
:p 150
313.d:
ऐशादावम्बुपादौ च यमराज्यञ्च वाह्यतः /
कालीनारवमाली कालीनामाक्षमालिनी //
:प् 150
313.m:
In the northeast and other quarters, the foot of water, and outside, the realm of Yama. / [Then write:] kālīnāravamālī kālīnāmākṣamālinī
[Page 150]

313.s:
māmodetattadomomā rakṣata svasva bhakṣavā /
yamapāṭaṭayāmaya maṭamo ṭaṭa moṭamā //
313.d:
मामोदेतत्तदोमोमा रक्षत स्वस्व भक्षवा /
यमपाटटयामय मटमो टट मोटमा //
313.m: māmodetattadomomā rakṣata svasva bhakṣavā / yamapāṭaṭayāmaya maṭamo ṭaṭa moṭamā

313.s:
vāmo bhūrivibhūmeyā ṭaṭa rīśva śvarī ṭaṭa /
yamarājādvāhyato vaṃ taṃ toyaṃ māraṇātmakaṃ //
313.d:
वामो भूरिविभूमेया टट रीश्व श्वरी टट /
यमराजाद्वाह्यतो वं तं तोयं मारणात्मकं //
313.m: vāmo bhūrivibhūmeyā ṭaṭa rīśva śvarī ṭaṭa / Outside the realm of Yama, [write] vaṃ, taṃ, water, causing death.

313.s:
kajjalaṃ nimbaniryāsamajjāsṛgviṣasaṃyutam /
kākapakṣasya lekhanyā śmaśāne vā catuṣpathe //
313.d:
कज्जलं निम्बनिर्यासमज्जासृग्विषसंयुतम् /
काकपक्षस्य लेखन्या श्मशाने वा चतुष्पथे //
313.m: With lampblack, neem sap, marrow, blood, and poison mixed together, / with a crow-quill pen, in a cremation ground or at a crossroads,

313.s:
nidhāpayet kumbhādhastādvalmīke vātha nikṣipet /
vibhītadrumaśāsvādho yantraṃ sarvārimardanam //
313.d:
निधापयेत् कुम्भाधस्ताद्वल्मीके वाथ निक्षिपेत् /
विभीतद्रुमशास्वाधो यन्त्रं सर्वारिमर्दनम् //
313.m: he should place it beneath a pot or cast it into an anthill, / or under a branch of a vibhītaka tree—this yantra crushes all enemies.

313.s:
likheccānugrahañcakraṃ śuklapatre 'tha bhūrjake /
lākṣayā kuṅkumenātha sphaṭikācandanena vā //
313.d:
लिखेच्चानुग्रहञ्चक्रं शुक्लपत्रे ऽथ भूर्जके /
लाक्षया कुङ्कुमेनाथ स्फटिकाचन्दनेन वा //
313.m: He should also draw the grace-bestowing wheel on white paper or birch bark, / with lac, saffron, or camphor and sandalwood,

313.s:
bhuvi bhittau pūrvadale(1) nāma madhyamakoṣṭhake /
khaṇḍe tu vārimadhyasthaṃ oṃ haṃso vāpi paṭṭiśam //
313.d:
भुवि भित्तौ पूर्वदले(1) नाम मध्यमकोष्ठके /
खण्डे तु वारिमध्यस्थं ओं हंसो वापि पट्टिशम् //
313.m: on the ground, on a wall, [or] on the eastern petal; the name [is written] in the central cell. / In the division, situated in the middle of water: "Oṃ haṃsaḥ" or a spear,

313.s:
lakṣmīślokaṃ śivādau ca rākṣasādikramāllikhet /
śrīḥsāmamomā sā śrīḥ sānau yājñe jñeyā nausā //
313.d:
लक्ष्मीश्लोकं शिवादौ च राक्षसादिक्रमाल्लिखेत् /
श्रीःसाममोमा सा श्रीः सानौ याज्ञे ज्ञेया नौसा //
313.m: and he should write the Lakṣmī verse starting from the north-east in order toward the south-west: / śrīḥsāmamomā sā śrīḥ sānau yājñe jñeyā nausā

313.s:
māyā līlā lālī yāmā yājñe jñeyā nausā māyā /
yatra jñeyā vahiḥ śīghrā dikṣuraṃ kalasaṃ vahiḥ //
313.d:
माया लीला लाली यामा याज्ञे ज्ञेया नौसा माया /
यत्र ज्ञेया वहिः शीघ्रा दिक्षुरं कलसं वहिः //
313.m: māyā līlā lālī yāmā yājñe jñeyā nausā māyā / Where it is to be known outside, swiftly, a knife in the direction, an earthen pot outside,

313.s:
padmasthaṃ padmacakrañca bhṛtyujit svargagandhṛtiṃ /
śāntīnāṃ paramā sāntiḥ saubhāgyādipradāyakam //
313.d:
पद्मस्थं पद्मचक्रञ्च भृत्युजित् स्वर्गगन्धृतिं /
शान्तीनां परमा सान्तिः सौभाग्यादिप्रदायकम् //
313.m: the lotus wheel set in a lotus, conquering death, holding the scent of heaven, / the supreme peace among peaces, bestowing good fortune and other blessings.

313.s:
rudre rudrasamāḥ kāryāḥ koṣṭhakāstatra tā likhet /
omādyāhrūṃphaḍantā ca ādivarṇamathānutaḥ //
313.d:
रुद्रे रुद्रसमाः कार्याः कोष्ठकास्तत्र ता लिखेत् /
ओमाद्याह्रूंफडन्ता च आदिवर्णमथानुतः //
313.m: In the Rudra [sector], cells equal to the Rudras must be made; there he should write them, / beginning with oṃ, ending in hrūṃ phaṭ, and following the initial syllables

313.s:
vidyāvarṇakrameneva saṃjñāñca vaṣaḍantikāṃ /
:n
1 pūrvapade iti ña..
:p 151
adhasthāt pratyaṅgiraiṣā sarvakāmārthasādhikā //
313.d:
विद्यावर्णक्रमेनेव संज्ञाञ्च वषडन्तिकां /
:न्
1 पूर्वपदे इति ञ..
:प् 151
अधस्थात् प्रत्यङ्गिरैषा सर्वकामार्थसाधिका //
313.m:
in the order of the letters of the vidyā, and the name ending with vaṣaṭ.
[Footnote]
[Note on variant: 1 "pūrvapade"] [Page 151]
Below this is Pratyaṅgirā, accomplishing all desires and purposes.

313.s:
ekāśītipade sarvāmādivarṇakrameṇa tu /
ādimaṃ yāvadantaṃ syādvaṣaḍantañca nāma vai //
313.d:
एकाशीतिपदे सर्वामादिवर्णक्रमेण तु /
आदिमं यावदन्तं स्याद्वषडन्तञ्च नाम वै //
313.m: In eighty-one squares, [inscribing] all in the order of the primary letters / from the beginning to the end, and the name ending in vaṣaṭ—

313.s:
eṣā pratyaṅgirā cānyā sarvakāryādisādhanī /
nigrahānugrahañcakrañcatuḥṣaṣṭipadair likhet //
313.d:
एषा प्रत्यङ्गिरा चान्या सर्वकार्यादिसाधनी /
निग्रहानुग्रहञ्चक्रञ्चतुःषष्टिपदैर् लिखेत् //
313.m: this is another Pratyaṅgirā, fulfilling all undertakings and the like. / He should draw the wheel of restraint and grace with sixty-four squares.

313.s:
amṛtī sā ca vidyā ca krīṃ saḥ hūṃ nāmātha madhyataḥ /
phaṭkārādyāṃ patragatāṃ trihrīṃkāreṇa veṣṭayet //
313.d:
अमृती सा च विद्या च क्रीं सः हूं नामाथ मध्यतः /
फट्काराद्यां पत्रगतां त्रिह्रींकारेण वेष्टयेत् //
313.m: That is the nectar-like vidyā: "krīṃ saḥ hūṃ", and then the name in the center. / Beginning with "phaṭ", inscribed on the leaf, he should encircle it with three hrīṃ-syllables.

313.s:
kumbhavavaddhāritā sarvaśatruhṛt sarvadāyikā /
viṣannaśyet karṇajapādakṣarādyaiś ca daṇḍakaiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tvaritājñānaṃ nāma
trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
stambhanādimantrāḥ
313.d:
कुम्भववद्धारिता सर्वशत्रुहृत् सर्वदायिका /
विषन्नश्येत् कर्णजपादक्षराद्यैश् च दण्डकैः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्वरिताज्ञानं नाम
त्रयोदशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ चतुर्दशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
स्तम्भनादिमन्त्राः
313.m:
Worn like an amulet, it removes all enemies and grants everything. / Poison is destroyed by reciting [the mantra] in the ear with syllables and rod-like lines.
Thus ends the three hundred and thirteenth chapter, entitled "The Knowledge of Tvaritā", in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now begins the three hundred and fourteenth chapter:
Mantras for Immobilisation and Other Rites

314.s:
agnir uvāca
stambhanaṃ mohanaṃ vaśyaṃ vidveṣoccāṭanaṃ vade /
viṣavyādhimarogañca māraṇaṃ śamanaṃ punaḥ //
314.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
स्तम्भनं मोहनं वश्यं विद्वेषोच्चाटनं वदे /
विषव्याधिमरोगञ्च मारणं शमनं पुनः //
314.m: Agni said: / I will speak of immobilisation, delusion, subjugation, causing dissension, and driving away, / and also poison, disease, health, eradication, and pacification.

314.s:
bhūrje kūrmaṃ samālikhya tāḍanena ṣaḍṅgulam /
mukhapādacaturṣkeṣu tato mantraṃ nyaseddvijaḥ //
314.d:
भूर्जे कूर्मं समालिख्य ताडनेन षड्ङ्गुलम् /
मुखपादचतुर्ष्केषु ततो मन्त्रं न्यसेद्द्विजः //
314.m: Having drawn a tortoise on birch bark measuring six inches by striking, / in the four corners—the mouth and the feet—the twice-born should then deposit the mantra:

314.s:
catuṣpādeṣu krīṃ kāraṃ hrīṃ kāraṃ mukhamadhyataḥ /
garbhe vidyāṃ tato likhya sādhakaṃ pṛṣṭhato likhet //
:p 152
314.d:
चतुष्पादेषु क्रीं कारं ह्रीं कारं मुखमध्यतः /
गर्भे विद्यां ततो लिख्य साधकं पृष्ठतो लिखेत् //
:प् 152
314.m:
The syllable "krīṃ" in the four feet, the syllable "hrīṃ" in the center of the mouth; / having then written the vidyā in the belly, he should write the practitioner on the back.
[Page 152]

314.s:
mālāmantraistu saṃveṣṭya iṣṭakopari sannyamet /
vidhāya kūrmapṛṣṭhena karālenābhisampaṭhenat //
314.d:
मालामन्त्रैस्तु संवेष्ट्य इष्टकोपरि सन्न्यमेत् /
विधाय कूर्मपृष्ठेन करालेनाभिसम्पठेनत् //
314.m: Having encircled it with mālāmantras, he should secure it upon a brick. / Having arranged it on the tortoise's back, he should recite it with a terrible form.

314.s:
mahākūrmaṃ pūjayitvā pādaprokṣantu nikṣipet /
tāḍayedvāmapādena smṛtvā śatruñca saptadhā //
314.d:
महाकूर्मं पूजयित्वा पादप्रोक्षन्तु निक्षिपेत् /
ताडयेद्वामपादेन स्मृत्वा शत्रुञ्च सप्तधा //
314.m: Having worshipped the great tortoise, he should cast the sprinkling of water from the foot; / he should strike it with the left foot, remembering the enemy, seven times.

314.s:
tataḥ sañjāyate śatrostambhanaṃ mukharāgataḥ /
kṛtvā tu bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ mālāmantraṃ samālikhet //
oṃ śatrusukhastambhanī kāmarūpā ālīḍhakarī
314.d:
ततः सञ्जायते शत्रोस्तम्भनं मुखरागतः /
कृत्वा तु भैरवं रूपं मालामन्त्रं समालिखेत् //
ओं शत्रुसुखस्तम्भनी कामरूपा आलीढकरी
314.m:
Then the immobilisation of the enemy's mouth occurs. / Having assumed a Bhairava form, he should write the mālāmantra:
"Oṃ, immobiliser of the enemy's happiness, having the form of desire, adopting the ālīḍha stance,

314.s:
hrīṃ pheṃ phetkāriṇī mama śatrūṇāṃ devadattānāṃ
mukhaṃ stambhaya 2 mama sarvavidveṣiṇāṃ mukhastambhanaṃ kuru 2
oṃ hūṃ pheṃ phetkāriṇi svāhā
phaṭ hetuñca samālikhya tajjapāntaṃ mahābalaṃ /
/
vāmenaiva nagaṃ śūlaṃ saṃlikheddakṣiṇe kare //
314.d:
ह्रीं फें फेत्कारिणी मम शत्रूणां देवदत्तानां
मुखं स्तम्भय 2 मम सर्वविद्वेषिणां मुखस्तम्भनं कुरु 2
ओं हूं फें फेत्कारिणि स्वाहा
फट् हेतुञ्च समालिख्य तज्जपान्तं महाबलं /
/
वामेनैव नगं शूलं संलिखेद्दक्षिणे करे //
314.m: hrīṃ pheṃ, O howling goddess, immobilise, immobilise the mouth of my enemies, Devadattas! Cause the immobilisation of the mouth of all who hate me, cause it! Oṃ hūṃ pheṃ, O howling goddess, svāhā!" / Having written "phaṭ" and the cause, ending with its recitation, it possesses great power. / In the left [hand] he should draw a mountain and a trident in the right hand.

314.s:
/
likhenmantramaghorasya saṃgrāme stambhayedarīn /
/
oṃ namo bhagavatyai bhagamālini visphura 2 spanda 2 nityaklinne drava 2 hūṃ
saḥ krīṃ kārākṣare svāhā ||
etena rocanādyaistu tilakāmmohayejjagat //
oṃ pheṃ hūṃ phaṭ phetkāriṇi hrīṃ jvala 2 trailokyaṃ mohaya 2
guhyakālike svāhā
314.d:
/
लिखेन्मन्त्रमघोरस्य संग्रामे स्तम्भयेदरीन् /
/
ओं नमो भगवत्यै भगमालिनि विस्फुर 2 स्पन्द 2 नित्यक्लिन्ने द्रव 2 हूं
सः क्रीं काराक्षरे स्वाहा ||
एतेन रोचनाद्यैस्तु तिलकाम्मोहयेज्जगत् //
ओं फें हूं फट् फेत्कारिणि ह्रीं ज्वल 2 त्रैलोक्यं मोहय 2
गुह्यकालिके स्वाहा
314.m:
He should write the mantra of Aghora; he immobilises enemies in battle:
"Oṃ, homage to the Blessed Lady Bhagavālinī! Flash forth, flash forth! Tremble, tremble! O ever-moist goddess, melt, melt! Hūṃ saḥ, O deity of the syllable krīṃ, svāhā!"
With this [mantra], by means of a forehead mark made with rocanā and other substances, one deludes the world.
"Oṃ pheṃ hūṃ phaṭ, O howling goddess, hrīṃ, blaze, blaze! Delude the three worlds, delude! To Guhyakālikā, svāhā!"

314.s:
anena tilakaṃ kṛtvā rājādīnāṃ vaśīkaraṃ /
gardhabhasya rajo gṛhya kusumaṃ sūtakasya ca //
314.d:
अनेन तिलकं कृत्वा राजादीनां वशीकरं /
गर्धभस्य रजो गृह्य कुसुमं सूतकस्य च //
314.m: Having made a forehead mark with this, it brings kings and others under control. / Taking the dust of a donkey and menstrual blood,

314.s:
nārīrajaḥ kṣipedrātrau śayyādau dveṣakṛdbhavet /
gokhurañca tathā śṛṅgamaśvasya ca khuraṃ tathā //
314.d:
नारीरजः क्षिपेद्रात्रौ शय्यादौ द्वेषकृद्भवेत् /
गोखुरञ्च तथा शृङ्गमश्वस्य च खुरं तथा //
314.m: if he casts a woman's menstrual blood at night upon the bed and the like, it creates hatred. / The hoof of a cow, a horn, and the hoof of a horse,

314.s:
śiraḥ sarpasya saṃkṣiptaṃ hṛheṣūccāṭanaṃ bhavet /
:p 153
karavīraśiphā pītā sasiddhārthā ca maraṇe //
314.d:
शिरः सर्पस्य संक्षिप्तं हृहेषूच्चाटनं भवेत् /
:प् 153
करवीरशिफा पीता ससिद्धार्था च मरणे //
314.m:
and the head of a snake, cast into houses, cause driving away.
[Page 153]
Yellow oleander root consumed with white mustard brings about death.

314.s:
vyālachucchundarīraktaṃ karavīraṃ tadarthakṛt /
saraṭaṃ ṣaṭpadañcāpi tathā karkaṭavṛścikam //
314.d:
व्यालछुच्छुन्दरीरक्तं करवीरं तदर्थकृत् /
सरटं षट्पदञ्चापि तथा कर्कटवृश्चिकम् //
314.m: The blood of a snake and a musk-shrew, and oleander, accomplish that purpose. / A lizard, a six-footed insect, a crab, and a scorpion—

314.s:
cūrṇīkṛtya kṣipettaile tadabhyaṅgaś ca kuṣṭhakṛt /
oṃ navarahāya sarvaśatrūn mama sādhaya 2 māraya 2 oṃ soṃ maṃ
vuṃ cuṃ oṃ śaṃ vāṃ keṃ oṃ svahā
anenārkaśatair arcya śmaśāne tu nidhāpayet //
314.d:
चूर्णीकृत्य क्षिपेत्तैले तदभ्यङ्गश् च कुष्ठकृत् /
ओं नवरहाय सर्वशत्रून् मम साधय 2 मारय 2 ओं सों मं
वुं चुं ओं शं वां कें ओं स्वहा
अनेनार्कशतैर् अर्च्य श्मशाने तु निधापयेत् //
314.m:
having powdered them, he should throw them into oil; anointing with that causes leprosy.
"Oṃ, to the nine planets: subdue my all enemies, subdue! Kill them, kill them! Oṃ soṃ maṃ buṃ cuṃ oṃ śaṃ vāṃ keṃ oṃ svāhā!"
Having worshipped with this using one hundred arka flowers, he should deposit it in a cremation ground.

314.s:
bhūrje vā pratimāyāṃ vā māraṇāya riporgrahāḥ /
oṃ kuñjarī brahmāṇī / oṃ mañjarī māheśvarī / oṃ vetālī
kaumārī oṃ kālī vaiṣṇavī / oṃ aghorā vārāhi / oṃ vetālī
intrāṇī urvaśī / oṃ jayānī yakṣiṇī / navamātaro he mama
śatruṃ gṛhṇata 2
bhūrje nāma riporlikhya śmaśāne pūjite mriyet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe stambhanādimantrā nāma
caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nānāmantrāḥ
314.d:
भूर्जे वा प्रतिमायां वा मारणाय रिपोर्ग्रहाः /
ओं कुञ्जरी ब्रह्माणी / ओं मञ्जरी माहेश्वरी / ओं वेताली
कौमारी ओं काली वैष्णवी / ओं अघोरा वाराहि / ओं वेताली
इन्त्राणी उर्वशी / ओं जयानी यक्षिणी / नवमातरो हे मम
शत्रुं गृह्णत 2
भूर्जे नाम रिपोर्लिख्य श्मशाने पूजिते म्रियेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे स्तम्भनादिमन्त्रा नाम
चतुर्दशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ पञ्चदशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
नानामन्त्राः
314.m:
[Written] on birch bark or an image, the planets are for killing the enemy.
"Oṃ Kuñjarī Brahmāṇī; Oṃ Mañjarī Māheśvarī; Oṃ Vetālī Kaumārī; Oṃ Kālī Vaiṣṇavī; Oṃ Aghorā Vārāhī; Oṃ Vetālī Indrāṇī Urvaśī; Oṃ Jayānī Yakṣiṇī. O nine Mothers, seize my enemy, seize!"
Having written the enemy's name on birch bark, when it is worshipped in the cremation ground, he dies.
Thus ends the three hundred and fourteenth chapter, entitled "Mantras for Immobilisation and Other Rites", in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now begins the three hundred and fifteenth chapter:
Various Mantras

315.s:
agnir uvāca
ādau hūṃkārasaṃyuktā khecache padabhūṣitā /
vargātītavisargeṇa hrīṃ hūṃkṣepaphaḍantakā //
315.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
आदौ हूंकारसंयुक्ता खेचछे पदभूषिता /
वर्गातीतविसर्गेण ह्रीं हूंक्षेपफडन्तका //
315.m: Agni said: / Joined at the beginning with the syllable "hūṃ", adorned with the words "khecache", / with the visarga beyond the consonant classes, ending with hrīṃ, hūṃ, kṣepa, and phaṭ—

315.s:
sarvakarmakarī vidyā viṣasandhādimardanī /
:p 154
oṃ kṣecachetiprayogaś ca kāladaṣṭasya jīvane //
315.d:
सर्वकर्मकरी विद्या विषसन्धादिमर्दनी /
:प् 154
ओं क्षेचछेतिप्रयोगश् च कालदष्टस्य जीवने //
315.m:
this vidyā performs all acts and crushes poison, fever, and other ailments.
[Page 154]
The application of "Oṃ kṣecache" is for reviving someone bitten by death.

315.s:
oṃ hūṃ kekṣaḥ prayogoyaṃ viṣaśatrupramardanaḥ /
strīṃ hūṃ phaḍitiyogoyaṃ pāparogādikaṃ jayet //
315.d:
ओं हूं केक्षः प्रयोगोयं विषशत्रुप्रमर्दनः /
स्त्रीं हूं फडितियोगोयं पापरोगादिकं जयेत् //
315.m: "Oṃ hūṃ kekṣaḥ": this application crushes poisons and enemies. / "Strīṃ hūṃ phaṭ": this combination conquers sins, diseases, and the like.

315.s:
khecheti ca prayogo 'yaṃ vighnaduṣṭādi vārayet(1) /
hrūṃ strīṃ omitiyogo 'yaṃ yoṣidādivaśīkaraḥ //
315.d:
खेछेति च प्रयोगो ऽयं विघ्नदुष्टादि वारयेत्(1) /
ह्रूं स्त्रीं ओमितियोगो ऽयं योषिदादिवशीकरः //
315.m: And "khe che": this application ward offs obstacles, evil beings, and the like. / "Hrūṃ strīṃ oṃ": this combination subjugates women and others.

315.s:
khe strīṃ khe ca prayogo 'yaṃ vaśāya vijayāya ca /
aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ spheṃ kṣauṃ bhagavati ambike kubjike spheṃ oṃ
bhaṃ taṃ vaśanamo aghorāya sukhe vrāṃ vrīṃ kili kili viccā
sphrauṃ he sphraṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ śrīmiti kubjikāvidyā
sarvakarā smṛtā
bhūyaḥ skandāya yānāha mantrānīśaś ca tān vade //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāmantrā nāma
pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sakalādimantroddhāraḥ
315.d:
खे स्त्रीं खे च प्रयोगो ऽयं वशाय विजयाय च /
ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं स्फें क्षौं भगवति अम्बिके कुब्जिके स्फें ओं
भं तं वशनमो अघोराय सुखे व्रां व्रीं किलि किलि विच्चा
स्फ्रौं हे स्फ्रं श्रीं ह्रीं ऐं श्रीमिति कुब्जिकाविद्या
सर्वकरा स्मृता
भूयः स्कन्दाय यानाह मन्त्रानीशश् च तान् वदे //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानामन्त्रा नाम
पञ्चदशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ षोडशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
सकलादिमन्त्रोद्धारः
315.m:
"Khe strīṃ khe": this application is for subjugation and victory. / "Aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ spheṃ kṣauṃ bhagavati ambike kubjike spheṃ oṃ bhaṃ taṃ vaśanamo aghorāya sukhe vrāṃ vrīṃ kili kili viccā sphrauṃ he sphraṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ śrīm": thus the Kubjikā lore / is remembered as accomplishing all tasks. / Again, I shall speak the mantras that the Lord taught to Skanda.
Thus ends the three hundred and fifteenth chapter, named "Various Mantras", in the Mahāpurāṇa called the Āgneya.
Now, the three hundred and sixteenth chapter:
Extraction of the Mantras of Sakala and Others.

316.s:
īśvara uvāca
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ śūnyaṃ kalāḍhyaṃ svamalaṅkṛtam /
kṣapaṇaṃ kṣayamantasthaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ cāṣṭamaṃśivam //
316.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
सकलं निष्कलं शून्यं कलाढ्यं स्वमलङ्कृतम् /
क्षपणं क्षयमन्तस्थं कण्ठोष्ठं चाष्टमंशिवम् //
316.m: The Lord said: / Sakala, Niṣkala, Śūnya, Kalāḍhya, Svamalaṅkṛta, / Kṣapaṇa, Kṣayamantastha, and the eighth is Kaṇṭhoṣṭha-Śiva.

316.s:
prāsādasya(2) parākhyasya smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ(3) guhāṣṭadhā /
:n
1 ripuduṣṭādi vārayediti ka.. , ṭa.. ca
2 prasādasyeti kha..
3 smṛtirūpamiti kha..
:p 155
sadāśivasya śabdasya rūpasyākhilasiddhaye //
316.d:
प्रासादस्य(2) पराख्यस्य स्मृतं रूपं(3) गुहाष्टधा /
:न्
1 रिपुदुष्टादि वारयेदिति क.. , ट.. च
2 प्रसादस्येति ख..
3 स्मृतिरूपमिति ख..
:प् 155
सदाशिवस्य शब्दस्य रूपस्याखिलसिद्धये //
316.m:
The form of the Prāsāda called the Supreme, O Guha, is traditionally known to be eightfold,
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "ripuduṣṭādi vārayed" in ka.. and ṭa..]
[Footnote 2: "prasādasya" in kha..]
[Footnote 3: "smṛtirūpam" in kha..]
for the attainment of all success of Sadāśiva's sound-form.

316.s:
amṛtaścāṃśubhāṃścenduśceśvaraścogra ūhakaḥ /
ekapādena ojākhya auṣadhaścāṃśumān vaśī //
316.d:
अमृतश्चांशुभांश्चेन्दुश्चेश्वरश्चोग्र ऊहकः /
एकपादेन ओजाख्य औषधश्चांशुमान् वशी //
316.m: Amṛta, Aṃśubhān, Indu, Īśvara, Ugra, Ūhaka, / Ekapāda, Ojas, Auṣadha, Aṃśumān, Vaśin—

316.s:
akārādeḥ kṣakāraś ca kakārādeḥ kramādime /
kāmadevaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca gaṇeśaḥ kālaśaṅkarau //
316.d:
